groups.title: Checking a clear protective film

turns.speaker: F
turns.text: Two trim panels from this shipment look different under the inspection lamp. The one on the left looks cloudy. Do we need to send the whole shipment back?
turns.zh: 同批出貨的兩片飾板在檢驗燈下看起來不一樣。左邊那片看起來霧霧的。要把整批退回去嗎？

turns.speaker: M
turns.text: Not yet. The panels come with a clear protective film. It can look cloudy by itself. We have two spare strips cut from the same material. Try peeling the film off one strip. Leave the film on the panels from the shipment for now.
turns.zh: 先不要。飾板附有透明保護膜，膜本身可能呈霧狀。我們有兩片同材質的備用試片。試著撕掉其中一片的膜，這批貨的飾板先保留保護膜。

turns.speaker: F
turns.text: I’ll compare the two strips under this lamp. If the exposed strip still looks cloudy, should I ask the supplier to check the finish?
turns.zh: 我會在同一盞燈下比較兩片試片。若撕膜後還是霧霧的，要請供應商檢查表面處理嗎？

turns.speaker: M
turns.text: Yes. In that case, send the supplier a photo of both strips with the material label in view.
turns.zh: 要。那種情況下，拍一張包含兩片試片且材料標籤可見的照片寄給供應商。

groups.title: Repairing a reversible coat

turns.speaker: M
turns.text: The right pocket on my reversible coat has torn along the edge. I wear the dark side out on weekdays and the other side out on weekends. Can the pocket still open on both sides when you repair it?
turns.zh: 我的雙面大衣右邊口袋邊緣裂開了。平日我讓深色那面朝外，週末則讓另一面朝外。修補後，不管哪一面朝外，口袋都還能打開嗎？

turns.speaker: F
turns.text: Yes, if I repair the edge rather than cover the opening with a patch. It takes a little longer, but the pocket will work either way you wear it.
turns.zh: 可以，只要我修補邊緣，而不是用補丁蓋住開口。時間會長一些，但不論哪一面朝外，口袋都能使用。

turns.speaker: M
turns.text: That’s what I need. Could I pick it up Thursday morning? I need it for the evening.
turns.zh: 這就是我要的。我可以星期四早上來拿嗎？晚上會用到。

turns.speaker: F
turns.text: I can have it ready by noon Thursday. The shop closes at five, so you can collect it in the afternoon. Bring your receipt, not the old patch you showed me.
turns.zh: 星期四中午前可以修好。店裡五點關門，你下午可以來領。帶收據就好，不用帶剛才給我看的舊補丁。

groups.title: Which timestamp belongs in a production report?
groups.titleZh: 生產報告應採哪個時間戳記？

turns.speaker: M
turns.text: I measured the test unit at four twenty yesterday, but our shared report puts the reading at four thirty-eight. Can we correct the chart?
turns.zh: 我昨天四點二十分量測測試件，但共用報告把讀值標在四點三十八分。可以改圖表嗎？

turns.speaker: F
turns.text: Before you change anything, check the column headings. Four twenty is the measurement time. Four thirty-eight is when the reading was uploaded to the shared folder. The chart is using the upload column.
turns.zh: 更動前先看欄位標題。四點二十分是量測時間，四點三十八分是讀值上傳到共用資料夾的時間。圖表目前用的是上傳欄。

turns.speaker: M
turns.text: So we should keep both values in the data and point the chart at the measurement column?
turns.zh: 那麼資料保留兩個時間，把圖表改用量測欄？

turns.speaker: F
turns.text: Exactly. The upload time is useful when we investigate delays. Save a new chart and compare its first two points with the worksheet before sending it out.
turns.zh: 沒錯。調查延誤時，上傳時間有用。另存新圖表，寄出前先把前兩個資料點和工作表比對。

groups.title: Sharing a live order demonstration

turns.speaker: F
turns.text: I can show the slides from the room computer, but the customer wants to see our order screen change while I talk. The example account only works on my laptop.
turns.zh: 我可以用現場電腦放投影片，但客戶想看到訂單畫面在我解說時即時變動。示範帳號只能在我的筆電上用。

turns.speaker: M
turns.text: Use the room computer for the slides and connect your laptop to the second screen. The second screen shows whatever is connected to it, but people joining remotely only see what the room computer shares.
turns.zh: 投影片還是用現場電腦放，你的筆電接到第二個螢幕。第二個螢幕會顯示接到它的裝置畫面，但遠端與會者只看得到現場電腦分享的畫面。

turns.speaker: F
turns.text: Then they would miss the order demonstration. What if I join the meeting from my laptop as well?
turns.zh: 那遠端的人就看不到訂單示範了。如果我也用筆電加入同一場會議呢？

turns.speaker: M
turns.text: You can share the laptop screen in the same meeting, but keep that laptop muted and turn off its microphone. Use the room computer for sound so we don’t hear an echo.
turns.zh: 你可以在同一場會議裡分享筆電的畫面，但請把筆電靜音，並關閉它的麥克風。聲音用現場電腦，以免出現回音。

groups.title: Opening a locker at the pool
groups.titleZh: 游泳池置物櫃的開啟與換用

turns.speaker: F
turns.text: My wristband opened a locker before my lesson, but it isn’t working now. I remember the locker number. The class has just finished, and my towel and things are still inside.
turns.zh: 我的腕帶在上課前打得開置物櫃，但現在不行了。我記得櫃號。剛下課，我的毛巾和其他物品還在裡面。

turns.speaker: M
turns.text: I can look up the locker if you still have the band. If the band can’t be read, I’ll ask you to describe what is in the locker before I open it. We don’t issue a new band while the same locker is occupied.
turns.zh: 如果腕帶還在，我可以用它查置物櫃。如果讀不到，我會請你描述櫃內有哪些物品，再幫你打開。有東西還放在同一個櫃子裡時，我們不另發新腕帶。

turns.speaker: F
turns.text: I do have it. Can I leave the locker closed and use the same band for my next class this evening?
turns.zh: 腕帶還在。我可以先不開置物櫃，晚上上下一堂課時繼續用同一條腕帶嗎？

turns.speaker: M
turns.text: Not that locker. The pool closes between sessions, so please collect everything now. You can get a band for an empty locker when you come back.
turns.zh: 那個櫃子不行。游泳池兩個時段中間會關閉，所以請現在把東西全部拿走。你回來時可以領腕帶，使用一個空的置物櫃。

groups.title: Approving the first production color

turns.speaker: F
turns.text: The supplier sent swatches for all three colors. We planned to order the pale blue first, but the blue sample was made with a different material from the one in our order.
turns.zh: 供應商把三種顏色的樣片都寄來了。我們原定先訂淺藍色，但這片藍色樣片的材料和訂單上的不同。

turns.speaker: M
turns.text: Then don’t use it to approve production. A color sample is only useful here if it’s on the specified material. The grey one is right, but it isn’t the color the customer chose.
turns.zh: 那就不要用它核准量產。在這裡，要用指定材料製成的顏色樣片才有用。灰色那片材料正確，但不是客戶選的顏色。

turns.speaker: F
turns.text: The supplier can send another blue swatch on Thursday or make the blue parts now from the order specification. Which should we ask for?
turns.zh: 供應商可以星期四再寄一片藍色樣片，也能照訂單規格現在就做藍色零件。我們應該請他們做哪項？

turns.speaker: M
turns.text: Ask for the swatch. We can reserve their production slot, but don’t give permission to start until we’ve checked it.
turns.zh: 請他們寄樣片。我們可以先保留供應商的生產時段，但要等檢查過樣片才准許開工。

turns.text: We have Court Two booked at four. I can see the net is in place, but there’s a barrier at the gate. Is that booking still going ahead?
turns.zh: 我們預約四點的二號球場。球網已架好，但入口有路障。預約還能照常嗎？

turns.speaker: M
turns.text: No. The crew repainted the lines today. The court stays closed until they remove the barrier, even though the net is back up. Court Three is free at five, or you can use the practice wall from four.
turns.zh: 不行。工作人員今天重畫了場地線。球網雖已架回去，但路障移開前不開放。三號球場五點有空，或是四點起可以使用練習牆。

turns.speaker: F
turns.text: My doubles partner has to leave by five. Can I keep the original booking and hit balls against the wall now?
turns.zh: 我的雙打搭檔最晚五點就得離開。我可以保留原預約，現在先對牆練球嗎？

turns.speaker: M
turns.text: Use the wall, but cancel Court Two at the desk. The wall doesn’t need a booking. I’ll give you a credit for the closed court.
turns.zh: 可以用練習牆，但請到櫃檯取消二號球場。練習牆不必預約。我會就球場未開放提供抵用額度。

groups.title: Separating mixed revisions at receiving
groups.titleZh: 進料時區分混在一起的版本

turns.speaker: M
turns.text: We got two items in separate shipping boxes. Each box has the same lot number. The packing list shows two revisions, but the items look the same. Should I put them in one bin?
turns.zh: 我們收到兩件分開裝箱的貨。兩個外箱上的批號一樣。裝箱明細列了兩個版本，但這兩件貨看起來一樣。我該把它們放進同一個料盒嗎？

turns.speaker: F
turns.text: No. Use the small revision mark next to the mounting hole, not the lot number on the box. Enter a separate count for each revision. Leave any board with an unreadable mark out of both counts.
turns.zh: 不要。要看安裝孔旁的小型版本標記，而不是外箱上的批號。每個版本的數量要分開登記。標記無法辨讀的板子，兩個版本都不要計入。

turns.speaker: M
turns.text: I can read the revision mark on the first card. A label hides the mark on the second card. Should I take the label off?
turns.zh: 我看得清楚第一片板的版本標記。第二片板的標記被貼紙蓋住了。我該把貼紙撕掉嗎？

turns.speaker: F
turns.text: Leave the label in place. Set that board aside on the inspection shelf, and tell the inspector where the label covers the mark.

groups.title: Counting cafeteria food scraps accurately
groups.titleZh: 正確記錄餐廳廚餘重量

turns.speaker: F
turns.text: The dish station reported eight kilograms from its green tub, and the prep station reported five. The numbers have gone into tomorrow’s report, but one person says the tubs themselves were included.
turns.zh: 清洗區回報綠桶秤得八公斤，備料區回報五公斤。數字已放進明天的報告，不過有人說連桶子本身也算進去了。

turns.speaker: M
turns.text: Find out which station reset the scale with an empty tub on it. If they did that, their number is already the weight of the food scraps. Don’t subtract the tub again.
turns.zh: 先查哪一區在空桶放上秤時把秤歸零了。如果有做這步，回報的已是廚餘重量，不要再扣一次桶重。

turns.speaker: F
turns.text: The dish station says the scale still showed the empty tub’s weight before they added anything. The prep station confirms they reset it.
turns.zh: 清洗區說還沒放廚餘時，秤上仍顯示空桶的重量。備料區確認有歸零。

turns.speaker: M
turns.text: Then only the dish station needs a correction. Ask them to weigh their own empty tub this afternoon. We can’t assume both tubs weigh the same.
turns.zh: 那就只要更正清洗區的數字。請他們下午秤自己的空桶；不能假設兩個空桶重量一樣。

groups.title: Reviewing a prototype vibration chart

turns.speaker: M
turns.text: I’m preparing the vibration chart for tomorrow’s customer call. The largest spike is at the far right. I thought I should circle it as the worst result.
turns.zh: 我在準備明天與客戶通話要用的振動圖。最大尖峰在最右側。我想把它圈起來，當作最差的測試結果。

turns.speaker: F
turns.text: Check the grey band on the chart. It marks the time after we switched the motor off. That spike is from lifting the unit off the stand, not from running the motor.
turns.zh: 看圖上的灰色區段。那是馬達關閉後的時段。尖峰是把機體抬離支架時造成的，不是馬達運轉造成的。

turns.speaker: M
turns.text: Should I crop the chart at the motor shutoff, so the customer doesn’t have to see the grey band?
turns.zh: 我要從馬達關閉的地方裁掉後面，讓客戶不用看灰色區段嗎？

turns.speaker: F
turns.text: Keep the full chart. Add a note explaining the grey band, and circle the largest spike to the left of it.
turns.zh: 保留整張圖，加註灰色區段的意思，並圈出它左側最大的尖峰。

groups.title: Collecting a pottery piece after firing

turns.speaker: F
turns.text: I’m collecting the blue mug I made at the weekend class. The pickup shelf has two blue mugs, but the paper label I put on mine is missing.
turns.zh: 我來領週末課做的藍色馬克杯。領取架上有兩個藍杯，但我貼的紙標不見了。

turns.speaker: M
turns.text: We take paper labels off before firing. Look underneath. Each member pressed a different stamp into the clay. The stamp should still be visible.
turns.zh: 進窯燒製前會把紙標拿掉。看看杯底。每位學員在陶土上壓了不同的印記，應該還能看見。

turns.speaker: F
turns.text: One has my little triangle, but its handle feels rough. Can I take it home and bring it back next week?
turns.zh: 有一個是我的小三角形，但杯把摸起來有點粗。我可以先帶回家，下週再帶來嗎？

turns.speaker: M
turns.text: If you want us to smooth the handle, leave it on the repair shelf today. Write your phone number on a new paper tag, so we can contact you when it’s ready.
turns.zh: 若要我們磨平杯把，今天就留在維修架上。在新紙標籤上寫電話號碼，好了我們會通知你。

groups.title: Releasing a corrected staff directory
groups.titleZh: 發布修正後的員工名錄

turns.speaker: F
turns.text: A visitor went to Rosa’s old desk. I saved Desk Nine in the index at eleven yesterday. Did they open a copy from before my change?
turns.zh: 有位訪客去了羅莎以前的座位。我昨天十一點已把索引裡的座位改成九號並存檔。他會不會開到我更改前的版本？

turns.speaker: M
turns.text: We exported at eleven forty. I moved her map marker from Desk Five after lunch. Edits don’t change that PDF. Rosa has to stay upstairs until one.
turns.zh: 我們十一點四十分匯出的。午餐後我才把平面圖上她的標記移離五號座位。編輯原始檔不會改到這份 PDF。羅莎得留在樓上到一點。

turns.speaker: F
turns.text: What can Communications see before Facilities approves the file?
turns.zh: 設施管理部門核准檔案前，公關部可以看哪些資料？

turns.speaker: M
turns.text: Her name, not her desk number. If visitors can’t finish at reception, the counter can get the new number on a piece of paper until the new directory arrives.
turns.zh: 只給他們她的姓名，不給座位號碼。如果訪客無法在接待櫃檯辦完事情，可以先給櫃檯一張寫有新座位號碼的紙，等新版名錄送達後再換用新版。

turns.speaker: F
turns.text: Can we post the approved PDF before seeing the proof?
turns.zh: 我們可以在看到校樣之前，先把核准的 PDF 放上網站嗎？

turns.speaker: M
turns.text: Yes. Print from that file, but keep the proof here.
turns.zh: 可以。用同一個檔案送印，但把校樣留在我們這裡。

groups.title: Taking a bicycle on a weekend ferry
groups.titleZh: 週末搭渡輪攜帶自行車

turns.speaker: F
turns.text: I bought two walk-on tickets for the ten o’clock ferry. We decided to bring our bicycles. Can we just show the same tickets at the ramp?
turns.zh: 我買了兩張十點渡輪的未攜車的乘客票。我們決定帶自行車。可以直接在登船坡道出示原票嗎？

turns.speaker: M
turns.text: Your passenger tickets are still valid, but you need one bicycle tag for each bike. We’ve only got one tag left for that departure. The crossing takes twenty-five minutes. If you want to travel together with both bikes, the eleven o’clock ferry still has space.
turns.zh: 乘客票仍有效，但每輛自行車各要一張掛牌。那班只剩一張。航程是二十五分鐘。如果兩個人要帶兩輛車一起搭，十一點那班還有空位。

turns.speaker: F
turns.text: We have to meet our friends on the other side before eleven. Is there a place to leave both bikes here?
turns.zh: 我們要在十一點前到對岸跟朋友碰面。這裡有地方可以停放兩輛車嗎？

turns.speaker: M
turns.text: Yes. The racks beside the ticket office are free. Lock both bicycles there, then use the tickets you already have to board the ten o’clock ferry on foot.
turns.zh: 有。售票處旁的車架免費，兩輛車都鎖在那裡，再用原票步行登上十點那班渡輪。

groups.title: Collecting staff jackets
groups.passage: If you are working at the exhibition this weekend, collect your jacket from the staff entrance on Friday. We have placed each ordered jacket in a bag with the worker’s name on it. Try on your jacket before you leave. If you need a different size, take the bag it came in to the fitting desk. The jackets for the evening crew have red tags. They are not spare jackets. The fitting desk has a separate supply, but there are no jackets in size XL today. If you need that size, leave your name. We’ll check the next delivery on Saturday morning.
groups.passageZh: 本週末會到展覽工作的人員，請於週五到員工入口領取外套。我們已把每件訂好的外套裝袋，並在袋上寫了工作人員的名字。離開前請先試穿外套。如果需要換尺寸，請把原本裝外套的袋子帶到試穿櫃檯。晚班人員的外套有紅色標籤。這些外套不是備用品。試穿櫃檯另有一批外套，但今天沒有 XL（加大）尺寸的備品。如果你需要這個尺寸，請留下名字；我們會在週六早上查看下一批到貨有沒有這個尺寸。

The fitting desk has a separate supply, but there are no jackets in size XL today. If you need that size, leave your name. We’ll check the next delivery on Saturday morning.

groups.title: Sharing seeds at a neighborhood swap
groups.titleZh: 社區種子交換會的規則
groups.passage: Welcome to the neighborhood seed swap. The packets on the main table are for sharing. You may take two, even if you did not bring seeds today. If you bring seeds from your own garden, write the plant name and the month you collected them on the envelope. Then leave it at the check-in desk, not on the table. Our volunteers check the label before the packets go on the table. When a plant name is missing, the packet goes into a separate box for later identification. If you want an envelope for seeds you’ll bring next month, there are blank ones at the exit.
groups.passageZh: 歡迎來到社區種子交換會。主桌上的種子袋可供大家分享。即使你今天沒帶種子，也可以拿兩袋。如果你帶來自家花園的種子，請在信封上寫植物名稱和收集的月份，再把信封留在報到櫃檯，不要直接放上主桌。種子袋放上主桌前，志工會先查看標示。沒有植物名稱的種子袋會另外放進一個盒子，待日後辨識。下個月打算帶種子的人，可以在出口拿空信封。

If you bring seeds from your own garden, write the plant name and the month you collected them on the envelope. Then leave it at the check-in desk, not on the table. Our volunteers check the label before the packets go on the table. When a plant name is missing, the packet goes into a separate box for later identification. If you want an envelope for seeds you’ll bring next month, there are blank ones at the exit.

groups.title: Prototype clip briefing
groups.passage: This shelf holds several versions of the same clip. The blue clips are for today’s fit check, not for shipment. The white clips have already been checked against the drawing. Keep those in the covered tray until assembly asks for them. If a blue clip fits, mark the result on the worksheet; do not swap it into the covered tray. We need to compare the worksheet with the printer’s settings before we release any more clips. If you find a loose clip without a label, leave it in the empty bin so we can identify its version later.
groups.passageZh: 這個架子上有同一種卡扣的多個版本。藍色卡扣用於今天的試裝，不是要出貨。白色卡扣已與圖面核對完畢，請留在有蓋托盤，等組裝部門來取。如果藍色卡扣裝得上，請把結果登記在工作表，不要把它換到有蓋托盤裡。放行更多卡扣前，我們還需要比較工作表和列印機的設定。若發現一個散放、沒有標籤的卡扣，請放到空料盒，方便稍後辨認版本。

We need to compare the worksheet with the printer’s settings before we release any more clips. If you find a loose clip without a label, leave it in the empty bin so we can identify its version later.

groups.title: Repair café sign-out reminder
groups.passage: Before you leave the repair café today, check the sign-out card in your tool kit. The card lists the small items that can go home with you. Please return those items next Saturday. The long scissors on the common table are not part of any kit. You may use them here, but hand them back to a volunteer before you go. If your kit contains a broken item, write its name on the card rather than replacing it yourself. The volunteer will check the card and give you a replacement from the supply drawer.
groups.passageZh: 今天離開社區維修站前，請查看工具組裡的借用登記卡。卡上列的是可以帶回家的小工具，請在下週六歸還。公用桌的長剪刀不屬於任何工具組。你可以在這裡使用，但離開前須交回志工。工具組若有物品損壞，請在卡上寫下品名，不要自行替換。志工會看卡，再從備品抽屜拿替代品給你。
groups.audioScript: Before you leave the repair café today, check the sign-out card in your tool kit. The card lists the small items that can go home with you. Please return those items next Saturday. The long scissors on the common table are not part of any kit. You may use them here, but hand them back to a volunteer before you go. If your kit contains a broken item, write its name on the card rather than replacing it yourself. The volunteer will check the card and give you a replacement from the supply drawer.

groups.title: Orientation attendance notice
groups.passage: Staff who attended the weekend orientation should check the attendance list by Tuesday. The list confirms completion of the training; it does not record hours worked. For those hours, use the normal timesheet. If you joined the morning session in person and finished the afternoon session online, make sure the list shows both sessions. Some online entries are still missing. Please send your confirmation email to the training desk if that is the case. Do not add the missing session again in the registration system. The desk can match your email to the original booking.
groups.passageZh: 參加週末入職訓練的員工請最晚於週二查看出席名單。名單只用來確認完成訓練，不會記錄工時。工時要用一般工時表填報。如果你早上到場、下午在線上完成，請確認名單列出兩個時段。目前有些線上紀錄還不在名單上。如果是這個情況，請將確認郵件寄給訓練櫃檯。不要在報名系統裡重新加選缺漏的時段。櫃檯可以把你的郵件與原報名資料配對。
groups.audioScript: Staff who attended the weekend orientation should check the attendance list by Tuesday. The list confirms completion of the training; it does not record hours worked. For those hours, use the normal timesheet. If you joined the morning session in person and finished the afternoon session online, make sure the list shows both sessions. Some online entries are still missing. Please send your confirmation email to the training desk if that is the case. Do not add the missing session again in the registration system. The desk can match your email to the original booking.

groups.title: Using a lecture audio receiver
groups.titleZh: 講座輔聽接收器的使用方式
groups.passage: If you would like an audio receiver for tonight’s lecture, please collect one at the entrance table. Staff will ask for your seat number so they can bring a spare if yours stops working. Test the receiver before entering the hall. You will hear a recorded message at the table. Once you sit down, the lecture channel will remain quiet until the host starts. If you do not hear the test message, return to the table before taking your seat. At the end, put working receivers in the blue tray and report any problem to the volunteer beside it.
groups.passageZh: 如果今晚聽講座時想借用輔聽接收器，請到入口桌領取。工作人員會問你的座位號碼，好在接收器故障時送備用機過去。進會場前請先測試接收器，在入口桌會聽到一段錄好的訊息。就座後，在主持人開始前，講座頻道會保持安靜。若你沒有聽到測試訊息，請在就座前回入口桌。活動結束後，把正常運作的接收器放進藍色托盤；有任何問題請告訴托盤旁的志工。
groups.audioScript: If you would like an audio receiver for tonight’s lecture, please collect one at the entrance table. Staff will ask for your seat number so they can bring a spare if yours stops working. Test the receiver before entering the hall. You will hear a recorded message at the table. Once you sit down, the lecture channel will remain quiet until the host starts. If you do not hear the test message, return to the table before taking your seat. At the end, put working receivers in the blue tray and report any problem to the volunteer beside it.

groups.title: Reviewing a finished conference program
groups.passage: The conference programs are printed, but please hold the full batch at the binding station. At twelve, we’ll bring one finished copy to the reception desk. The event team needs to check where the fold falls on the room map. They have already approved the text. When you deliver the copy, open it to the map page and leave a removable slip, not a mark on the paper. If they ask for a wider fold margin, bring that copy back to me. Don’t change the layout until we’ve measured how much space they need.
groups.passageZh: 會議節目冊已印好，但請先把整批留在裝訂區。十二點時，我們會把一本成品送到接待櫃檯。活動團隊要確認折線落在會場平面圖的哪裡，文字內容已核准。送去時，請翻到平面圖那頁並放一張可取下的紙條，不要直接在紙上留下記號。如果他們要求加寬折頁留白，請把那本拿回給我。量出所需空間前，先不要改版面。
groups.audioScript: The conference programs are printed, but please hold the full batch at the binding station. At twelve, we’ll bring one finished copy to the reception desk. The event team needs to check where the fold falls on the room map. They have already approved the text. When you deliver the copy, open it to the map page and leave a removable slip, not a mark on the paper. If they ask for a wider fold margin, bring that copy back to me. Don’t change the layout until we’ve measured how much space they need.

groups.title: Collecting prepaid market orders
groups.titleZh: 領取市集已付款的預訂品
groups.passage: If you ordered anything from the Saturday market, please listen before you join the line. Because of the rain, all prepaid orders will be at the covered pickup counter beside the main gate. Stall numbers in your order message are still useful; read yours to the volunteer there so she can find the right bag. You don’t need to queue at the individual stalls. If you want to buy something you hadn’t ordered, use the stalls as usual. The counter can check a missing order, but it cannot accept payments for new purchases.
groups.passageZh: 如果你在週六市集有預訂，排隊前請先聽一下。因為下雨，所有已付款的預訂品都會移到主入口旁、有遮蔽的取貨櫃檯。訂單訊息裡的攤位號碼仍有用，請念給那裡的志工聽，方便她找對袋子。不必在個別攤位排隊。若想買沒預訂的東西，還是照常到各攤位購買。取貨櫃檯可以查找不到的訂單，但不收新購品的款項。
groups.audioScript: If you ordered anything from the Saturday market, please listen before you join the line. Because of the rain, all prepaid orders will be at the covered pickup counter beside the main gate. Stall numbers in your order message are still useful; read yours to the volunteer there so she can find the right bag. You don’t need to queue at the individual stalls. If you want to buy something you hadn’t ordered, use the stalls as usual. The counter can check a missing order, but it cannot accept payments for new purchases.

groups.title: Using a sample catalogue in training
groups.passage: For the training demo, open the sample catalogue, not the one our customers use. The sample catalogue works without an internet connection. A grey picture means the image file is not on this tablet. It does not mean the product is unavailable. If you get a question about stock, say the sample figures are for training only. Nobody should promise availability based on those figures. After class, note which picture was grey and send the product code to our media team. They can add the missing image to the sample catalogue before the next session.
groups.passageZh: 訓練示範時，請打開範例目錄，不要開啟客戶使用的目錄。範例目錄沒有網路也能用。圖片顯示灰色，表示這台平板沒有該圖片檔，不代表商品缺貨。如果有人問庫存，請說明範例數字只供訓練，不得據此向人保證有貨。下課後記下哪張圖片呈灰色，並把商品代碼寄給媒體團隊；他們能在下次上課前把缺少的圖補進範例目錄。
groups.audioScript: For the training demo, open the sample catalogue, not the one our customers use. The sample catalogue works without an internet connection. A grey picture means the image file is not on this tablet. It does not mean the product is unavailable. If you get a question about stock, say the sample figures are for training only. Nobody should promise availability based on those figures. After class, note which picture was grey and send the product code to our media team. They can add the missing image to the sample catalogue before the next session.

groups.title: Submitting observations from a bird count
groups.titleZh: 提交鳥類計數觀察紀錄
groups.passage: Thanks for taking part in this morning’s bird count. Please send us one list per household by tonight. If two people in the same household saw the same bird together, put it on the list once, not twice. We want reports from the pond path, not from the feeding table in the visitor center. If you could not identify a bird, write its size and where you saw it. Do not guess the species. A photo is helpful, but you can still send a list without one.
groups.passageZh: 謝謝大家參加今天早上的鳥類觀察計數。請每戶在今晚以前提交一份名單。同一戶的兩個人如果一起看到同一隻鳥，只要在那份名單上記一次，不要記兩次。我們要收的是池塘步道的觀察紀錄，不是遊客中心餵食台的紀錄。若無法辨認某隻鳥，就寫下它的大小和看到牠的地點，不要猜種類。附照片會有幫助，但沒有照片也能交名單。
groups.audioScript: Thanks for taking part in this morning’s bird count. Please send us one list per household by tonight. If two people in the same household saw the same bird together, put it on the list once, not twice. We want reports from the pond path, not from the feeding table in the visitor center. If you could not identify a bird, write its size and where you saw it. Do not guess the species. A photo is helpful, but you can still send a list without one.

groups.title: Caption review memo
groups.passage:
PEBBLE RIVER EXHIBITS
Caption review memo | Tuesday

We have prepared a working copy of the entrance video for the caption review. Reviewers may change the copy, but the source recording must remain [131] _____ so that the editor can recover any material removed by mistake.

Write both the exact time and the first visible word in the log. Enter the timestamp [132] _____ the first word in the same row so the editor can locate the right caption. [133] _____ The editor will use those suggested phrases to update the text transcript, but the video itself will not be edited during this review.

If a name cannot be verified against the audio, mark the row with an M instead of guessing. Please hand the completed log to Lydia [134] _____ noon tomorrow. She will combine the notes after that deadline and bring them to the afternoon meeting.
groups.passageZh:
石河展覽部
字幕校對備忘錄｜星期二

我們已為入口影片製作一份字幕校對用工作副本。校對人員可以修改副本，但原始錄影必須維持 [131] _____，這樣剪輯人員才能找回誤刪的素材。

請在紀錄表登記確切時間及畫面上的第一個詞，兩項都要填。請將時間戳記 [132] _____ 第一個詞寫在同一列，讓剪輯人員找到正確字幕。[133] _____ 剪輯人員會依照建議的字詞更新文字逐字稿，但本次校對期間不會剪輯影片本身。

如果無法從音訊核對一個名字，請在該列標 M，不要猜測。請 [134] _____ 明天中午把填好的紀錄表交給 Lydia。她會在截止後彙整意見，並帶到下午會議。

groups.title: Borrowing a jigsaw kit
groups.passage:
ORCHARD LANE PUZZLE EXCHANGE
Borrower notice

Each jigsaw kit has a foldout picture in its sleeve. It shows what the finished puzzle should look like and must be [135] _____ with the kit, not kept as a souvenir.

Found an extra piece from a different puzzle? Place it in an unsealed envelope and write only the kit number on the outside. Please do not add the piece to the kit. The desk keeps extra pieces [136] _____ until their own puzzles are identified.

Borrowers may send us a photo of their completed puzzle for the display wall. [137] _____ A submission does not extend the loan period.

Return the kit [138] _____ you have finished the puzzle or not. A six-day loan gives others a fair turn; there is no need to assemble the whole picture before the deadline.
groups.passageZh:
果園巷拼圖交換站
借用須知

每套拼圖的保護套內有一張摺頁圖，顯示完成後的樣子。摺頁圖必須隨套件 [135] _____，不能留下當紀念。

發現一片不屬於這套的拼片嗎？請把它放進未封口的信封，只在外面寫套件號碼。請勿把那片放進套件；櫃檯會將多出的拼片 [136] _____ 保管，直到查明原屬哪一套為止。

借用者可以寄來完成的拼圖照片，供展示牆使用。[137] _____ 投稿不會延長借期。

[138] _____ 是否已經拼完，都請歸還套件。每次借期六天，讓其他人也輪得到，不用趕在截止前拼完整幅圖。

groups.title: Preparing an interpreter briefing
groups.passage:
COPPERLEAF FORUM
Note to session hosts | Interpreter briefing

The booth interpreters will prepare from the briefing packet. A speaker’s slides are helpful, but please send a short glossary as well. Each uncommon name or abbreviation must be [139] _____ so the interpreters know how to say it aloud.

The packet lists rooms as “East” and “West.” Do not include a room number as a substitute [140] _____ the room name. The interpreters will use those names to select the correct channel.

[141] _____ The example section gives the interpreters a chance to practice; it is separate from the material they will interpret at the forum.

Any edits typed into the file will not appear in copies that have already been handed out. If a speaker makes a change on the morning of the forum, tell the floor lead directly [142] _____ the shared file has already been printed for the booths. The lead will deliver an update to the right booth.
groups.passageZh:
銅葉論壇
致各場主持人｜口譯簡報資料

口譯間的口譯員會依簡報資料做準備。講者的投影片有幫助，但也請附上一份簡短詞彙表。每個少見的人名或縮寫都必須 [139] _____，口譯員才知道如何唸出來。

資料將會場寫為「東室」和「西室」。請勿用房號 [140] _____ 房間名稱。口譯員會根據這些名稱選擇正確的聲道。

[141] _____ 範例區讓口譯員可以練習，不屬於論壇正式要口譯的內容。

更新檔案不會改到已發出去的紙本。如果講者在論壇當天上午更改內容，請直接告訴場務組長，[142] _____ 共用檔案已印成供口譯間使用的紙本。組長會把更新送到正確的口譯間。

groups.title: Hosting a neighborhood night walk
groups.titleZh: 夜間觀星散步活動志工須知
groups.passage:
MOONBRIDGE SKY CLUB
Volunteer note | Night walk

Some visitors will arrive after the briefing. Assign one volunteer to wait at the pathway entrance and welcome [143] _____. The rest of the team can walk ahead.

Visitors should not turn on their flashlights during the walk. [144] _____, the guide can use a dim red light to illuminate features along the path.

[145] _____ That pause gives visitors a chance to let their eyes adjust before looking for the first pair of stars.

Leave the route markers in place for both groups to use. Return them to the cupboard [146] _____ the last group has passed the viewing area. Do not collect the markers while either group is still using them.
groups.passageZh:
月橋觀星社
志工須知｜夜間散步

有些訪客會在說明結束後到達。請安排一位志工在步道入口等候並接待 [143] _____。團隊其他人可先前進。

訪客在步行期間不應打開手電筒。[144] _____，領隊可以用微弱的紅光照亮步道旁的景物。

[145] _____這段短暫停留能讓訪客在尋找第一組星星之前，先讓眼睛適應一下。

沿途標示請留在原位，讓兩組都可使用。[146] _____ 最後一組離開觀賞區，再把標示收回儲物櫃。只要還有一組在使用，就不要收走。

groups.title: Saturday’s oral-history listening table
groups.titleZh: 週六的口述歷史聆聽站
groups.passage:
Subject: Saturday’s oral-history listening table
From: Rina, library programs
To: Emil, neighborhood archives

Hi Emil,

I've reserved the foyer from eleven to two for playback. Once the duty manager clears Recording Room B for us, we can name it in the public program; the sound team’s technical booking isn’t enough. If building staff haven’t confirmed an unlock time, mark the room’s opening time as pending. If the request is still pending at 10:30 Saturday, the exam team gets the room. On the internal host sheet, list setup the host can do and put anything still awaiting someone else in Notes. Don’t list a room in the public program before it’s approved.

I’ve penciled in two foyer headset stations. A reply by Friday evening will hold them. Leona, Saturday’s host, can prepare one station for each cleared excerpt she receives; until then, a held station can stay off the floor plan without going back into the equipment pool.

Could “Have a story to share?” go under “Help shape the next archive event,” rather than below the list of Saturday’s equipment? I can have the archives address printed there. One more thing for the program editor: a listed location with no time or note still defaults to eleven. At the moment the equipment list says “headsets” and “microphone”; only the headsets are part of our confirmed foyer setup, and even if Room B is cleared, the microphone is for the host’s introduction.

For this event, permission to play an excerpt in the foyer doesn’t include permission to email the recording afterwards. We have a summary sheet people may take away. People can open the archive’s public catalog entries from its links, but they won’t hear the recording there unless the archive has published it. Send any separate online release to the archive, not to Saturday’s host. An online release allows the archive to add an audio link to the catalog; it doesn’t authorize us to email people the file.

Thanks,
Rina
groups.passageZh:
主旨：週六的口述歷史聆聽站
寄件人：里娜，圖書館活動組
收件人：艾米爾，社區檔案館

艾米爾，你好：

我已預留大廳十一點到兩點的時段播放錄音。值班主管核准我們使用 B 錄音室後，就能在公開活動表上列出錄音室；只有音響組做的設備預約還不夠。如果館務人員尚未確認開門時間，請標示「開放時間待定」。如果週六十點半申請仍在審核，錄音室就歸試務團隊使用。給主持人的內部工作表上，請列出主持人自己能做的準備工作；還在等其他人處理的事項請放在備註。未核准的房間不要列入公開活動表。

我暫時排了大廳兩個耳機聆聽站。你週五傍晚前回覆，就可以保留這兩站。週六的主持人莉歐娜，每收到一段已獲授權的錄音摘錄，就能準備一站；在摘錄送達前，已保留的站可以先不標在場地配置圖上，不必把設備放回共用設備庫。

可以把「你有故事想分享嗎？」放在「一起規劃檔案館的下次活動」下面，而不是放在週六的設備清單下方嗎？我可以請人把檔案館的聯絡地址印在那裡。另外提醒活動表的編輯：有列出場地但未標時間或附註時，預設是十一點開放。目前設備清單寫著「耳機」和「麥克風」；確定會在大廳使用的只有耳機，即使 B 錄音室獲得核准，麥克風也只是給主持人做開場介紹。

這次活動獲准在大廳播放的錄音摘錄，不表示事後也能把檔案用電子郵件寄出去。現場有一張簡介可以帶走。透過簡介上的連結可開啟檔案館的公開目錄項目，但要等檔案館發布錄音，才聽得到。若另有線上發布授權，請交給檔案館，不要給週六的主持人。線上授權允許檔案館在目錄上加音訊連結，不授權我們把檔案寄給別人。

謝謝，
里娜

groups.title: Sorting decisions after a planning meeting
groups.titleZh: 規劃會議後如何整理決議
groups.passage:
ALDER ROW PLANNING OFFICE
Note for the meeting recorder

At the end of the meeting, divide the notes into Actions, Ideas, and Waiting. An item belongs under Actions only if the group has agreed to do it and has named both an owner and a date. Enthusiasm for an idea is not approval to start it. List proposals that the group has not accepted under Ideas.

Before filing an agreed action, check whether it still needs approval from anyone outside the room. If it does, put it under Waiting, even if an owner and a date have been assigned. Keep both the owner and the penciled date in the notes, but mark the date as provisional.

If the group withdraws an idea instead of acting on it, keep a short line in the meeting archive. Do not carry the idea forward onto the next meeting's agenda. The archive is for later reference and is not the work schedule.
groups.passageZh:
赤楊街規劃辦公室
會議記錄者須知

會議結束時，請把筆記分為「行動」、「構想」和「等待中」。只有與會者同意執行，且同時指定負責人和日期，才列入「行動」。大家對構想很有興趣，不等於已核准著手。與會者尚未同意的提案列入「構想」。

歸類已同意的行動前，請先查看是否還需要與會人員以外的人核准。若需要，即使負責人和日期都已指定，仍要列入「等待中」。在紀錄中保留負責人及所填的日期，並註明該日期為暫定。

如果與會者決定撤回構想而不執行，請在會議存檔中留一句簡記。不要再將該構想帶入下一次議程。存檔供日後查閱，不是工作排程。

groups.title: Joining a percussion workshop
groups.passage:
JUNIPER STEPS COMMUNITY STUDIO
Workshop welcome page

The two-hour workshop starts with a demonstration, then lets visitors try three kinds of percussion. No instrument is needed to attend. We lend small drums for the exercises; visitors may bring their own shakers if they want to compare their sound.

For the first exercise, sit anywhere you can see the instructor's hands. Stay in the same seat when we switch instruments. Helpers bring a drum to each seat, so do not join the line for the instrument cupboard. That line is only for people returning loaned drums at the end.

We are testing a new quiet table near the back. It will not be used for the loud group exercise. Visitors at that table can still follow the exercise by tapping a pad, and they may tell a helper at any time if they want to move back to the regular tables.

The workshop ends at noon, but the recording desk remains open until twelve thirty. It is for those who wish to hear a sample from the demonstration, not for extra time with the loaned instruments.
groups.passageZh:
杜松階社區工作室
工作坊迎新資訊

兩小時的工作坊從示範開始，之後訪客可試三種打擊樂。不必自備樂器。我們會借出小鼓供大家練習；想比較聲音的人可以自帶沙鈴。

第一項練習請坐在能看見老師雙手的位置。更換樂器時請留在同一座位。助手會把鼓送到每個座位，所以請不要到樂器櫃前排隊。那條隊伍只供課程結束時歸還借來的小鼓。

我們正在試用後方的新安靜桌。那桌不做大聲的團體練習；坐那裡的訪客仍能敲練習墊跟著做，也隨時可以告訴助手想回一般桌。

工作坊中午結束，但錄音櫃檯開到十二點半。櫃檯讓想聽示範片段的人試聽，並非延長借用樂器時間。

groups.title: Measuring when a press is available
groups.titleZh: 沖壓設備可用時間紀錄
groups.passage:
FARFIELD ASSEMBLY
Utilization note | What belongs in the idle column

The weekly sheet measures time when a press could have taken work but was not being used. Count time in Idle only while a press is available and has no assigned job or setup in progress. The count is not based on whether parts are coming out.

A job's approved setup counts as use from the minute it begins, even if the first piece will not be produced until later. Separately, a press taken out of service for scheduled maintenance is Unavailable, not Idle. A row marked “job ready” tells the planner that a job can start soon; it does not by itself change the press status.

A single time window may contain several statuses. Enter each interval under its actual status. Do not copy the whole elapsed time into Idle just because the same operator was present throughout. The operator may write an explanation in the notes, but the weekly totals use the timed intervals, not the notes.
groups.passageZh:
遠野組裝廠
設備利用率須知｜哪些時間算待命

每週紀錄衡量沖壓設備可以接工作卻未被使用的時間。只有設備可用、沒有指派工作且沒有準備作業進行時，才把時間記在「待命」。是否正有零件產出，不是計算依據。

經核准的工作準備自開始的那一分鐘就算使用中，即使第一件要稍後才會生產。因排定保養而停用的沖壓設備要記作「不可用」，不是「待命」。「工作就緒」標記讓規劃員知道某項工作即將可開始，但單靠這個標記不會改變設備狀態。

一個時間範圍可能涵蓋數種狀態。請將各段時間記入實際對應的欄位。不要因全程是同一位操作員在場，就把全部經過時間放進「待命」。操作員可在註記寫下說明，但每週總數只採計各段時間，不採註記欄。

groups.title: Using the exercise yard with a dog
groups.passage:
BIRCH QUAY EXERCISE YARD
Notice at the entrance

There are two fenced areas. The stretch yard is for active play. The quiet yard is for dogs that need space from other dogs. Please choose by how your dog behaves around other dogs, not by its size. A calm large dog may use the quiet yard; a lively small dog should use the stretch yard.

The quiet yard is for one household at a time. Turn the sign on the outside gate to IN USE as you enter. If someone is waiting, please finish within fifteen minutes. Do not shorten your visit just because someone passes on the path. People waiting to use the yard should stand by the blue post where you can see them.

Clip on your dog's lead before opening either gate, not once you are on the public path. The quiet yard will be closed on Wednesday morning while its latch is replaced. The stretch yard and the public path will stay open. Please do not use the stretch yard as a temporary quiet yard.
groups.passageZh:
樺木碼頭犬隻活動場
入口公告

場內有兩個圍起來的區域。活動區供狗狗奔跑玩耍；安靜區供需要與其他狗保持距離的狗狗使用。請依照你的狗與其他狗相處時的表現選擇，不是依體型。性情平靜的大型犬可以使用安靜區；活潑的小型犬應使用活動區。

安靜區一次只供一戶人家使用。進場時請將外門上的牌子翻到「使用中」。如果有人等候，請在十五分鐘內結束。不要只因有人經過步道就提早離開。想使用場地的人請站在藍色柱子旁，讓場內的人看得見。

打開任何一道門之前，請先替狗扣好牽繩，不要等到了公共步道才扣。週三上午安靜區關閉以更換門閂。活動區及公共步道照常開放。請勿把活動區當成臨時的安靜區。

groups.title: Choosing a replacement inner tube
groups.titleZh: 挑選替換用的自行車內胎
groups.passage:
THE WHEELHOUSE BULLETIN
What to bring when you buy an inner tube

Start by checking the side of your current tyre. On a label such as 32–622, the first number is the tyre width and the second is the diameter at the point where the tyre sits on the rim. Both are in millimetres. The same tyre may carry other numbers, including an air pressure. If you find the label hard to read, photograph the whole side of the tyre so the shop can identify the right pair of numbers.

An inner tube box often shows a range of tyre widths. A box marked 28–35 mm is suitable for either a 28 mm or a 35 mm tyre of the stated diameter, and for widths in between. The width range does not make the tube suitable for a different diameter. Check the diameter first, then look for a range that includes your tyre width.

The valve is a separate choice. If the new tube's valve is thicker than the old one, it may not fit through the hole in the wheel rim. If you are unsure which kind you have, take a picture of the valve before you take the old tube out. The shop can identify it without asking you to bring in the whole bicycle.
groups.passageZh:
車輪工坊通訊
購買內胎時要帶哪些資訊

先看看目前這條外胎的側面。以 32–622 這種標記為例，前面是外胎寬度，後面是外胎胎唇在輪圈上就位處的直徑。兩個數字的單位都是毫米。同一條外胎也可能標示其他數字，例如胎壓。如果標記不易辨認，可以把外胎整個側面拍下來，讓店家找出正確的一對數字。

內胎盒上常標示適用的外胎寬度範圍。例如標示 28–35 毫米的盒子，表示在盒上指定的直徑下，內胎可搭配寬度為 28 毫米、35 毫米或兩者之間的外胎。外胎寬度符合範圍，並不表示這個內胎可用於不同直徑。請先確認直徑，再找寬度範圍涵蓋自己外胎的款式。

還需要另外確認氣嘴。如果新內胎的氣嘴比舊的粗，可能穿不過輪圈上的孔。如果你不確定使用的是哪種氣嘴，拆下舊內胎前先拍一張氣嘴的照片。店家可以根據照片辨認，不用把整台自行車帶過去。

groups.title: Confirming socket heights before installation
groups.titleZh: 插座安裝前的高度確認
groups.passage:
FROM: Rina Patel, Facilities
TO: Installation Team
SUBJECT: Socket heights for the new workroom

Please use drawing W-14 to mark the wall before fitting the sockets. All heights on the drawing run from the top of the finished floor to the centre of the socket. The grey concrete you can see now is not the finished floor. A dark pencil line on each column shows where the top of the floor covering will be. Start your measurements at that line, not at the concrete.

The cabinet maker's earlier sketch gives one height for every socket. W-14 gives a different height for the wall behind the sink. The drawing was revised so the sockets there would clear the raised strip at the back of the counter. Use the earlier sketch to check the positions of the cabinets, but do not copy socket heights from it.

Wall C is a special case. The cabinet at that wall has not been delivered, and the team cannot check whether a side panel would cover the leftmost socket. Mark the proposed centre and photograph it, but do not drill that opening. The other marked openings on Wall C are already cleared for drilling. Send the photograph to Facilities today so we can review it before the cabinet arrives.
groups.passageZh:
寄件人：設施部 芮娜．帕特爾
收件人：安裝小組
主旨：新工作室的插座高度

請用 W-14 圖面在牆上標出位置，再安裝插座。圖面上的所有高度都是從完成地坪的上表面量到插座中心。目前看得到的灰色混凝土不是完成地坪。每根柱子上都有一道深色鉛筆線，表示地板面層上表面的位置。請從那道線開始量，不要從混凝土表面量。

櫥櫃製作者之前的草圖對所有插座都標同一個高度。W-14 則為水槽後方那面牆指定了不同高度。修改圖面是為了讓該處插座避開檯面後緣凸起的擋條。先前的草圖可用來確認櫥櫃位置，但不要照抄當中的插座高度。

C 牆是特例。那面牆的櫥櫃還沒送到，因此小組無法確認側板會不會擋住最左邊的插座。請標出預計的中心位置並拍照，但不要鑽出那個開口。C 牆上其餘已標記的開口都已核准鑽孔。請今天將照片傳給設施部，讓我們能在櫥櫃到貨前審查。

groups.title: Selecting a dashboard demonstration source
groups.titleZh: 選擇儀表板示範資料來源
groups.passage:
DOCUMENT 1 — LARCHMONT SYSTEMS | Quick guide for demonstrations

Preview mode shows fictional orders. You can change their status to demonstrate the editing controls. Those edits stay in the current preview session and do not change any customer records. If you select a different preview scenario, the edits from the previous scenario are discarded.

Replay mode shows a saved sequence of fictional orders as they arrived in a trial. You may pause the sequence or jump to a later point, but the editing controls are disabled. Use a replay to show how the queue changed over time, not to show how an operator edits an order.

When sharing a clip with a partner, leave the source label visible. It appears at the upper left of the dashboard. If the clip ends with a close-up, add a title card naming the source before that portion; a source label shown only at the very beginning is not enough.

DOCUMENT 2 — TEAM CHAT | Thursday morning

Evan: For the first clip I was asked to show how a worker moves a fictional order to Held. For the second, I need to show the queue growing from the first rush to the second. I cannot show either clip from the live dashboard.

Mina: Use the Pine preview first. Choose the new status, then record the revised row before you open the Cedar preview. Evan, I will record the second segment myself so that we do not both make the same clip. I will crop the last six seconds for a close-up.

Evan: I will leave the upper-left corner visible throughout my clip. Tell me if you need help with the file for the close-up.
groups.passageZh:
文件一 — 落葉松系統｜示範快速指南

預覽模式顯示虛構的訂單。你可以變更訂單狀態來示範編輯功能。變更只保留在當前的預覽工作階段，不會變動任何客戶紀錄。一旦改選不同的預覽情境，先前情境的編輯結果便會捨棄。

重播模式顯示已儲存的序列，呈現虛構訂單在試行期間陸續進入系統的過程。你可以暫停序列，或跳到後面的時間點，但不能使用編輯功能。請用重播呈現佇列如何隨時間改變，不要用它呈現操作人員如何編輯訂單。

將影片片段分享給合作夥伴時，請讓資料來源標籤保持可見。標籤位於儀表板左上角。如果片段最後有特寫，請在該段落前加上一張標示來源的字卡；只有開頭顯示來源標籤是不夠的。

文件二 — 團隊聊天｜週四上午

Evan：第一段影片要示範工作人員如何將一筆虛構訂單的狀態改為「暫緩」。第二段要顯示從第一波尖峰到第二波尖峰，佇列如何變長。這兩段都不能使用即時儀表板來錄製。

Mina：先選「松木」預覽。選好新狀態後，錄下變更後的那一列，再開「雪松」預覽。Evan，第二段我會自己錄，避免我們兩個重複錄同一段。我會裁切最後六秒的畫面做特寫。

Evan：我的片段會從頭到尾都保留左上角。如果你需要我協助處理特寫片段的檔案，請跟我說。

groups.title: A community radio broadcast and its highlights
groups.titleZh: 社區電台直播與精華節目
groups.passage:
DOCUMENT 1 — RIVER BANK RADIO | Listener bulletin

Our Saturday programme, Voices by the River, is live from 4 to 5 p.m. The sound from the studio will go out on both FM and the website. The website does not let listeners go back to an earlier point during the live broadcast.

We release a highlights programme on Tuesday. It contains selected interview extracts, not a repeat of the entire hour. For music performed live in the studio, the programme lists the song titles instead of including a recording. A short announcement from the presenter may be added separately if a planned segment is moved.

The monthly bulletin goes to print in advance. If a guest arrives late, the host can change the order without changing the broadcast start time. The online running order shows the current plan.

DOCUMENT 2 — MESSAGE FROM THE HOST | Saturday, 3:35 p.m.

A bus breakdown has delayed our guest Ren Ito. We will begin at the usual time with the short interview about the river ferry. The Hill Steps Trio will then perform two songs live in the studio. Ren will join us at about 4:40 to talk about the floating gardens, instead of opening the programme as the bulletin says.

The web team has already changed today's running order. There is still a link to last Tuesday's highlights below it. It is correctly dated and has nothing to do with today's delay, so please leave it in place. For this Tuesday's highlights, I plan to include an extract from Ren's interview. I will also record a short announcement explaining why Ren did not open the programme.
groups.passageZh:
文件一 — 河岸電台｜聽眾公告

我們週六的節目《河畔之聲》在下午四點到五點直播。錄音室的聲音會透過 FM 廣播和網站同步播出。節目直播時，網站無法讓聽眾回到較早的播出時間點。

我們會在週二推出精華節目，內容是節選的訪談片段，而不是重播完整的一小時。錄音室現場演奏的音樂在精華中只會列出曲名，不會放演奏錄音。若有預定的段落更動，主持人可能會另外加錄一段簡短說明。

紙本月刊會提前付印。若來賓遲到，主持人可以調整順序，不必更改直播開始時間。網站上的節目流程反映目前的安排。

文件二 — 主持人訊息｜週六下午 3:35

公車故障耽誤了來賓 Ren Ito。我們照原定時間開播，先進行河上渡輪的短訪談。接著山階三重奏會在錄音室現場演奏兩首歌。Ren 大約下午 4:40 加入我們，談談水上花園，不會像月刊所寫的那樣為節目開場。

網站團隊已更新今天的節目流程。流程下方仍有上週二精華節目的連結。它的日期正確，與今天的延誤無關，請保留在原處。至於本週二的精華節目，我已決定會節錄 Ren 的訪談。我也會錄一段簡短說明，解釋 Ren 為何沒有為節目開場。

groups.title: Choosing an appointment reminder method
groups.passage:
DOCUMENT 1 — FENWICK SERVICE DESK | Counting rules

An eligible case is a customer request opened during the trial for which the customer agreed to receive reminders. Count one eligible case per request, even if several messages are exchanged about it.

To count as resolved without a repeat contact, a case must be marked solved and the customer must not contact the desk again about the same request by the end of the following business day. Record any reminder sent after a case is closed in a separate column, whether the customer replies or not.

DOCUMENT 2 — PILOT RESULTS | Appointment reminder trial

Read the attached results chart. The three method names refer to three separate sets of eligible cases, not three stages of the same process.

DOCUMENT 3 — INTERNAL EMAIL | Monday's recommendation

Please recommend a method only if it had at least thirty eligible cases, at least three quarters of its eligible cases were resolved without a repeat contact, and it sent no reminders after closure. A high resolution rate does not cancel out a failure on either of the other requirements.

Monday's email to the managers should include the full results chart, not just the row for the method we recommend. The chart is for review: do not change the reminder method used by the service desk until the managers have decided.
groups.passageZh:
文件一 — 芬威克服務中心｜計數規則

符合條件的案件，指在試行期間建立，而且客戶同意接收提醒的服務請求。每項請求只計為一件，即使雙方已為此互傳好幾封訊息。

若要計為「未再聯絡即結案」，案件必須已被標記為解決，且直到下一個工作日結束前，客戶都沒有為同一項請求再次聯絡服務中心。案件結案後若仍寄出提醒，請另列一欄記錄，不論客戶是否回覆。

文件二 — 試行結果｜預約提醒試行

請閱讀所附的結果表。三種方式分別用於三組不同的符合條件案件，不是同一流程的三個階段。

文件三 — 內部郵件｜週一的建議

只有同時符合以下三項條件的方式才可推薦：至少三十件符合條件的案件、其中至少四分之三未再聯絡即結案，以及結案後沒有再發出任何提醒。解決率再高，也不能彌補另外兩項中任何一項未達標。

週一給主管的郵件應附完整結果表，不只是建議採用方式的那一列。表格供主管審查；主管作出決定前，不要更改服務中心實際使用的提醒方式。

groups.title: Collecting and exchanging a harvest box
groups.passage:
DOCUMENT 1 — HEDGEROW HARVEST SALE | Collection guide

If you paid in advance for a River box or a Hill box, show your collection code at the entrance desk. You can give the code to another person to collect for you. A name alone is not enough because several customers may have the same name.

The website shows what growers expect to supply. If a grower falls short, volunteers may pack a similar item without changing the price or the box name. At collection, the volunteer will tell you about any substitution before you accept the box.

You may exchange a sealed box for the other kind at the exchange table if spare boxes are available. The entrance desk cannot make exchanges. The table exchanges whole boxes, never a single item. When there are no spares, uncollected reservations cannot be used to make an exchange.

DOCUMENT 2 — MESSAGE TO VOLUNTEERS | Saturday morning

We received fewer pears than expected. The Hill boxes now contain two small bags of plums in place of the pears. The River boxes are unchanged. Do not put a different box name on a Hill label. We have added a red dot beside the printed name so the entrance volunteer knows to tell the customer about the plums.

No River boxes are available for walk-in sale this morning; they have all been reserved. If the entrance desk later releases any uncollected boxes, they will be offered for walk-in sale, not for exchanges. There are a few spare Hill boxes at the exchange table.

DOCUMENT 3 — VOICEMAIL TRANSCRIPT | Noa to Remy, 9:20 a.m.

Could you collect my box for me? I reserved a Hill box. The code on my receipt is KITE-24. I want the Hill box even if the pears have changed. I was also going to buy a River box for my neighbour. If they say there are no River boxes for sale yet, please just collect mine, then ask the entrance volunteer when to check again. Please do not swap my box.
groups.passageZh:
文件一 — 樹籬豐收市集｜領取指南

如果已預付 River 或 Hill 蔬果箱，請在入口服務台出示領取代碼。你可以把代碼交給別人代領。單憑姓名不能領取，因為可能有客人同名。

網站所列的是農家預計供應的品項。如果農家的貨不足，志工可用類似品項替代，價格和蔬果箱名稱不變。領取時，志工會在你收下蔬果箱之前說明任何替代品項。

交換台若有備用蔬果箱，可把未拆封的一整箱換成另一種。入口服務台不能辦理交換。交換台只交換整箱，不交換單一品項。若沒有備用箱，不得把尚未領取的預訂箱拿來交換。

文件二 — 給志工的訊息｜週六上午

收到的梨子比預期少。現在 Hill 箱用兩小袋李子替代梨子。River 箱的內容不變。請不要在 Hill 的標籤上改寫其他箱名。我們在印好的箱名旁加了紅點，入口志工看見後就知道要向客人說明換成李子的事。

今天早上的 River 箱都已被預訂，現場沒有 River 箱可買。如果入口服務台稍後釋出未領取的蔬果箱，那些箱子會提供現場購買，不拿來交換。交換台有少量備用的 Hill 箱。

文件三 — 語音留言逐字稿｜Noa 給 Remy，上午 9:20

你可以幫我領蔬果箱嗎？我預訂的是 Hill 箱，收據上的代碼是 KITE-24。就算梨子換成別的，我還是要 Hill 箱。我原本也打算幫鄰居買一箱 River。如果他們說 River 箱暫時還不對外賣，請先領取我那箱，再問入口志工何時可以回來看看。請不要把我的蔬果箱換掉。

groups.title: Reading a production monitoring export
groups.titleZh: 判讀生產監測匯出報表
groups.passage:
DOCUMENT 1 — HEMLOCK INSTRUMENTS | Shift export guide

The first field gives the number of alert messages received while the connection was confirmed. A zero means the receiver was connected and did not receive an alert during that checked interval. A dash means there is no confirmed connection for that interval. It does not mean the device sent nothing.

Report the duration of missing coverage separately. If a row covers only the connected part of a longer job, neither a zero nor a positive count proves what happened outside the confirmed interval. Do not estimate a missing count by copying from a neighbouring row.

DOCUMENT 2 — SHIFT LOG | Tuesday, Line 4

09:00–09:30 | Receiver connected throughout; count 2.
09:30–10:00 | No confirmed connection recorded; count —.
10:00–10:20 | Receiver connected throughout; count 0.

Job Fern ran from 09:40 to 10:20. No other receiver covered the line during the unconfirmed period. For jobs that extend across an unconfirmed interval, the export creates one covered row and a separate note about unavailable coverage.

DOCUMENT 3 — MESSAGE FROM QUALITY OPERATIONS | Wednesday morning

The first draft of the customer summary says “Job Fern: no alerts during the run.” Replace that sentence. State the period we actually checked and what the receiver got during that period. Name the earlier portion of the job as unconfirmed rather than filling in a number.

For our internal investigation, keep the earlier export untouched so we can compare it with a new one if a supervisor finds additional source logs. Please send me a revised customer summary today, but do not attach the internal shift log to it.
groups.passageZh:
文件一 — 鐵杉儀器｜班次報表匯出指南

第一個欄位記錄的是連線確認期間收到的警示訊息數。零表示在這段確認期間，接收器一直連線且未收到警示。破折號則表示無法確認這段期間有連線，不表示裝置未送出任何警示。

請另行報告缺少監測資料的時長。若某列只涵蓋一項較長工作的已確認連線部分，欄位不論是零或正數，都不能證明確認區間之外發生了什麼。請勿用相鄰資料列的數字來估填缺少的計數。

文件二 — 班次日誌｜週二，第 4 線

09:00–09:30｜接收器全程連線；警示數 2。
09:30–10:00｜無已確認連線的紀錄；警示數 —。
10:00–10:20｜接收器全程連線；警示數 0。

Fern 工作從 09:40 執行到 10:20。在連線未經確認的這段期間，沒有其他接收器監測該線。若工作的執行時間跨越連線未確認區間，匯出報表會為有資料的區間產生一列，並在附註另列無法確認的監測範圍。

文件三 — 品質作業部訊息｜週三上午

客戶摘要的第一版寫著「Fern 工作：整個執行期間沒有警示」。請替換這句話，寫出我們實際檢查的區間，以及這段期間接收器收到了什麼。請把工作較早的那一段標為「連線未確認」，而不填入一個數字。

為利內部調查，請讓較早的匯出報表維持原樣；若主管找到更多來源日誌，我們才能拿先前的匯出報表與新報表比對。請今天把修改後的客戶摘要送給我，但不要把內部班次日誌當成附件。

evidenceSpans.speaker: F
evidenceSpans.exactQuote: Two trim panels from this shipment look different under the inspection lamp. The one on the left looks cloudy. Do we need to send the whole shipment back?

vocabulary.note: 此處為外觀與表面檢查的零件。

questions.prompt: What does the man suggest the woman do to check whether the film is the cause?
questions.promptZh: 男方建議如何確認問題是否由保護膜造成？

options.text: Peel the film off all of the panels from the shipment.
options.zh: 撕掉整批飾板的保護膜。
options.whyZh: 出貨飾板的保護膜先保留。

options.text: Send the panels back before examining the spare strips.
options.zh: 先退回飾板，之後才檢查備用試片。
options.whyZh: 男方說先別退貨，先用試片檢查。

options.text: Move the cloudy panel away from the lamp and leave both strips alone.
options.zh: 把霧霧的飾板移離燈光，兩片試片都不動。
options.whyZh: 須撕掉其中一片試片的膜，不是把飾板移離燈。

options.text: Remove the film from one spare strip and leave the film on the panels from the shipment.
options.zh: 撕掉其中一片備用試片的膜，保留出貨飾板的膜。
options.whyZh: 男方限制只動一片試片，出貨飾板不撕膜。

questions.explanationZh: 男方限制只動一片試片，出貨飾板不撕膜。
questions.evidence: Not yet. The panels come with a clear protective film. It can look cloudy by itself. We have two spare strips cut from the same material. Try peeling the film off one strip. Leave the film on the panels from the shipment for now.

evidenceSpans.speaker: M
evidenceSpans.exactQuote: Not yet. The panels come with a clear protective film. It can look cloudy by itself. We have two spare strips cut from the same material. Try peeling the film off one strip. Leave the film on the panels from the shipment for now.

vocabulary.note: covering 可在檢驗前先保留，用備用試片比較。

questions.prompt: If the exposed strip is still cloudy, what should the woman send?
questions.promptZh: 如果撕膜後的試片仍霧霧的，女方該寄什麼？

options.text: A photo showing both strips and their material label.
options.zh: 一張兩片試片和材料標籤都入鏡的照片。
options.whyZh: 撕膜後仍霧霧的才請供應商檢查，且兩片試片和材料標籤都要拍進同一張照片。

options.text: A package containing the inspection lamp.
options.zh: 一個裝著檢驗燈的包裹。
options.whyZh: 需寄試片照片，不用寄檢驗燈。

options.text: A photo of the shipping carton without the strips.
options.zh: 一張沒有試片的外箱照片。
options.whyZh: 照片要包含兩片試片，不是只拍外箱。

options.text: A list of customer addresses for the shipment.
options.zh: 這批貨的客戶地址清單。
options.whyZh: 要讓供應商看外觀及材質，不必提供客戶地址。

questions.explanationZh: 撕膜後仍霧霧的才請供應商檢查，且兩片試片和材料標籤都要拍進同一張照片。
questions.evidence: I’ll compare the two strips under this lamp. If the exposed strip still looks cloudy, should I ask the supplier to check the finish? / Yes. In that case, send the supplier a photo of both strips with the material label in view.

evidenceSpans.speaker: F
evidenceSpans.exactQuote: I’ll compare the two strips under this lamp. If the exposed strip still looks cloudy, should I ask the supplier to check the finish?

evidenceSpans.speaker: M
evidenceSpans.exactQuote: Yes. In that case, send the supplier a photo of both strips with the material label in view.

vocabulary.note: 此處表示拍照時要讓標籤入鏡。

questions.prompt: Why does the man mention that he wears the coat both ways?
questions.promptZh: 男方為什麼提到這件大衣兩面都會穿？

options.text: He wants one side of the coat to be made darker.
options.zh: 他想把大衣的一面染得更深。
options.whyZh: 深色只是原有的一面，不是要求染色。

options.text: He plans to wear two coats at the same time.
options.zh: 他打算同時穿兩件大衣。
options.whyZh: 對話談的是一件可反過來穿的大衣，沒有另一件。

options.text: He wants the pocket to remain usable with either side facing out.
options.zh: 他希望不論哪一面朝外，口袋都還能用。
options.whyZh: 說明平日與週末會翻面，隨即問修好後是否兩面都能使用口袋。

options.text: He wants the same patch placed on both sides.
options.zh: 他希望在兩面都貼上相同的補丁。
options.whyZh: 他要的是正常開口的口袋；覆住開口的補丁反而不符合目的。

questions.explanationZh: 說明平日與週末會翻面，隨即問修好後是否兩面都能使用口袋。
questions.evidence: Can the pocket still open on both sides when you repair it? / I wear the dark side out on weekdays and the other side out on weekends.

evidenceSpans.speaker: M
evidenceSpans.exactQuote: Can the pocket still open on both sides when you repair it?

evidenceSpans.speaker: M
evidenceSpans.exactQuote: I wear the dark side out on weekdays and the other side out on weekends.

vocabulary.note: reversible 指內外兩面都能朝外穿。

questions.prompt: What repair does the woman recommend?
questions.promptZh: 女方建議怎麼修？

options.text: Mend the torn edge without covering the opening.
options.zh: 修補裂開的邊緣，不蓋住開口。
options.whyZh: 她說要修邊而不是貼補丁蓋口，才能維持翻面時的功能。

options.text: Close one side of the pocket permanently.
options.zh: 把口袋的一側永久封住。
options.whyZh: 男方想兩面都能用，女方也說她的修法能保留兩面的使用。

options.text: Attach a patch across both sides of the opening.
options.zh: 用補丁把開口的兩側都蓋住。
options.whyZh: 女方明確不採用會蓋住開口的補丁做法。

options.text: Remove the pocket and sew a new one to the dark side.
options.zh: 拆掉口袋，在深色那面縫上一個新的。
options.whyZh: 她提出修補破邊，不是拆掉整個口袋或限制只能從深色面使用。

questions.explanationZh: 她說要修邊而不是貼補丁蓋口，才能維持翻面時的功能。
questions.evidence: I repair the edge rather than cover the opening with a patch.

evidenceSpans.speaker: F
evidenceSpans.exactQuote: I repair the edge rather than cover the opening with a patch.

vocabulary.term: cover the opening with a patch
vocabulary.note: patch 在這裡是補衣服用的布片。

questions.prompt: Which pickup plan fits what the woman says?
questions.promptZh: 哪個取件安排符合女方的說法？

options.text: Come Thursday morning with the old patch.
options.zh: 星期四早上帶舊補丁來取件。
options.whyZh: 她只保證中午前能備妥，並且明確不用帶舊補丁。

options.text: Wait until after five Thursday and bring the receipt.
options.zh: 星期四五點過後帶收據來。
options.whyZh: 收據正確，但五點關門後無法照她所說在下午取件。

options.text: Collect it in the evening without any documents.
options.zh: 晚上來取件，不用帶任何文件。
options.whyZh: 店五點關門，而且她要求帶收據。

options.text: Come Thursday afternoon before closing, with the receipt.
options.zh: 星期四下午打烊前帶收據來。
options.whyZh: 中午前備妥、五點關門、帶收據三項條件都符合。

questions.explanationZh: 中午前備妥、五點關門、帶收據三項條件都符合。
questions.evidence: I can have it ready by noon Thursday. / The shop closes at five, so you can collect it in the afternoon. / Bring your receipt, not the old patch you showed me.

evidenceSpans.speaker: F
evidenceSpans.exactQuote: I can have it ready by noon Thursday.

evidenceSpans.speaker: F
evidenceSpans.exactQuote: The shop closes at five, so you can collect it in the afternoon.

evidenceSpans.speaker: F
evidenceSpans.exactQuote: Bring your receipt, not the old patch you showed me.

vocabulary.note: pick up 在此指到店領取修好的衣物。

questions.prompt: What difference is the man concerned about?
questions.promptZh: 男方在意的是哪項差異？

options.text: The test unit and the report carry different serial numbers.
options.zh: 測試件與報告的序號不同。
options.whyZh: 對話中比的是兩個時間，未提到序號。

options.text: The same row lists two different measurement results.
options.zh: 同一列列了兩種量測結果。
options.whyZh: 差異是報告標示的時間，不是讀值本身有兩種。

options.text: The chart shows a later time than he measured the unit.
options.zh: 圖表時間比他量測測試件的時間晚。
options.whyZh: 男方說四點二十分量測，報告顯示四點三十八分，後者更晚。

options.text: The first two chart points have disappeared.
options.zh: 圖表前兩個資料點不見了。
options.whyZh: 前兩點是修正後要比對的項目，沒有說它們消失。

questions.explanationZh: 男方說四點二十分量測，報告顯示四點三十八分，後者更晚。
questions.evidence: I measured the test unit at four twenty yesterday, but our shared report puts the reading at four thirty-eight. Can we correct the chart? / Before you change anything, check the column headings. Four twenty is the measurement time. Four thirty-eight is when the reading was uploaded to the shared folder. The chart is using the upload column.

evidenceSpans.speaker: M
evidenceSpans.exactQuote: I measured the test unit at four twenty yesterday, but our shared report puts the reading at four thirty-eight. Can we correct the chart?

evidenceSpans.speaker: F
evidenceSpans.exactQuote: Before you change anything, check the column headings. Four twenty is the measurement time. Four thirty-eight is when the reading was uploaded to the shared folder. The chart is using the upload column.

vocabulary.note: 指正在測量的那一件樣品或裝置。

questions.prompt: Why does the woman want to keep the upload time in the data?
questions.promptZh: 女方為何要保留資料中的上傳時間？

options.text: It is the only time that should appear on the revised chart.
options.zh: 那是修正版圖表唯一應顯示的時間。
options.whyZh: 修正版要改用量測欄，不是繼續使用上傳欄。

options.text: It can help the team investigate delays.
options.zh: 可協助團隊查明延誤。
options.whyZh: 女方同意圖表用量測時間，但指出保留上傳時間有助於查明延遲。

options.text: It tells them when the technician started the measurement.
options.zh: 可得知技術人員何時開始量測。
options.whyZh: 上傳時間記的是資料到資料夾的時點，不是操作人員開始量測的時點。

options.text: It gives them the time when the worksheet was printed.
options.zh: 可得知工作表何時列印。
options.whyZh: 對話中上傳與列印無關，未提到紙本時間。

questions.explanationZh: 女方同意圖表用量測時間，但指出保留上傳時間有助於查明延遲。
questions.evidence: Before you change anything, check the column headings. Four twenty is the measurement time. Four thirty-eight is when the reading was uploaded to the shared folder. The chart is using the upload column. / So we should keep both values in the data and point the chart at the measurement column? / Exactly. The upload time is useful when we investigate delays. Save a new chart and compare its first two points with the worksheet before sending it out.

evidenceSpans.speaker: F
evidenceSpans.exactQuote: Before you change anything, check the column headings. Four twenty is the measurement time. Four thirty-eight is when the reading was uploaded to the shared folder. The chart is using the upload column.

evidenceSpans.speaker: M
evidenceSpans.exactQuote: So we should keep both values in the data and point the chart at the measurement column?

evidenceSpans.speaker: F
evidenceSpans.exactQuote: Exactly. The upload time is useful when we investigate delays. Save a new chart and compare its first two points with the worksheet before sending it out.

vocabulary.note: 這個欄位記上傳，不是量測時間。

questions.prompt: What should the man do before distributing the new chart?
questions.promptZh: 發出新圖表前，男方應先做什麼？

options.text: Compare its first two points against the worksheet.
options.zh: 把前兩個資料點與工作表比對。
options.whyZh: 女方最後直接指示，寄出前先和工作表比對最前面兩個資料點。

options.text: Delete the upload time from every row.
options.zh: 刪掉每一列的上傳時間。
options.whyZh: 女方說上傳欄要保留供調查延遲，不應刪除。

options.text: Measure the test unit again at four thirty-eight.
options.zh: 在四點三十八分重測測試件。
options.whyZh: 四點三十八分是上傳時間；不需要在該時間重新測量。

options.text: Put the two original charts in a different folder.
options.zh: 把原本的兩張圖表移到其他資料夾。
options.whyZh: 她要求另存新圖表並和工作表比對，沒有提到搬移兩張舊圖。

questions.explanationZh: 女方最後直接指示，寄出前先和工作表比對最前面兩個資料點。
questions.evidence: Exactly. The upload time is useful when we investigate delays. Save a new chart and compare its first two points with the worksheet before sending it out.

evidenceSpans.speaker: F
evidenceSpans.exactQuote: Exactly. The upload time is useful when we investigate delays. Save a new chart and compare its first two points with the worksheet before sending it out.

vocabulary.note: compare ... with 表示拿兩份資料互相比對。

questions.prompt: What does the customer want to see during the presentation?
questions.promptZh: 客戶希望在簡報時看到什麼？

options.text: A recorded tour of the training room.
options.zh: 一段預錄的訓練室介紹。
options.whyZh: 對話說用現場電腦放投影片；客戶想看的是即時訂單示範，不是場地介紹。

options.text: A list of people who are joining remotely.
options.zh: 遠端與會者名單。
options.whyZh: 對話提到遠端與會者，但沒有說客戶想看名單。

options.text: The order screen changing in real time.
options.zh: 訂單畫面即時變動。
options.whyZh: 女方一開始直接說客戶想在她解說時看訂單畫面即時變動。

options.text: A new set of printed instructions.
options.zh: 一套新版的紙本說明。
options.whyZh: 此次要看的是實際畫面，不曾提到印製說明。

questions.explanationZh: 女方一開始直接說客戶想在她解說時看訂單畫面即時變動。
questions.evidence: the customer wants to see our order screen change while I talk.

evidenceSpans.speaker: F
evidenceSpans.exactQuote: the customer wants to see our order screen change while I talk.

vocabulary.note: 指實際操作訂單時使用的介面，而非預先截下的圖片。

questions.prompt: If they connect the laptop to the second screen but do not share that laptop in the meeting, what will happen?
questions.promptZh: 如果筆電接到第二個螢幕，卻沒有在會議中分享筆電畫面，會發生什麼事？

options.text: The remote participants will see the laptop but not the slides.
options.zh: 遠端與會者會看到筆電畫面，但看不到投影片。
options.whyZh: 遠端接收的是現場電腦的畫面，投影片會從現場電腦播放。

options.text: People in the room can see the laptop demonstration, but remote participants cannot.
options.zh: 現場的人看得到筆電上的示範，遠端與會者則看不到。
options.whyZh: 接到第二個螢幕的筆電畫面只在現場顯示，遠端仍只能看到現場電腦分享的內容。

options.text: Everyone will see the laptop automatically once a cable is connected.
options.zh: 只要接上線，所有人就會自動看到筆電畫面。
options.whyZh: 接到現場的第二個螢幕，不等於在遠端會議中分享筆電畫面。

options.text: Neither group will be able to see any screen.
options.zh: 現場和遠端的人都看不到任何螢幕畫面。
options.whyZh: 不分享筆電不會讓現場螢幕或現場電腦的分享失效。

questions.explanationZh: 接到第二個螢幕的筆電畫面只在現場顯示，遠端仍只能看到現場電腦分享的內容。
questions.evidence: connect your laptop to the second screen. / The second screen shows whatever is connected to it / people joining remotely only see what the room computer shares. / Then they would miss the order demonstration.

evidenceSpans.speaker: M
evidenceSpans.exactQuote: people joining remotely only see what the room computer shares.

evidenceSpans.speaker: F
evidenceSpans.exactQuote: Then they would miss the order demonstration.

vocabulary.note: 指不在簡報現場，而透過線上會議參與。

questions.prompt: Why does the man ask the woman to mute her laptop and turn off its microphone?
questions.promptZh: 男方為什麼請女方將筆電靜音並關閉麥克風？

options.text: To avoid an echo in the meeting.
options.zh: 避免會議中出現回音。
options.whyZh: 男方請她只使用現場電腦處理聲音，明確說這是為了避免回音。

options.text: To keep the second screen from losing its connection.
options.zh: 避免第二個螢幕斷線。
options.whyZh: 第二個螢幕顯示的是接到它的裝置畫面；靜音是為了避免會議回音，不是為了維持畫面連線。

options.text: To make the account work on the room computer.
options.zh: 讓示範帳號可以在現場電腦上使用。
options.whyZh: 示範帳號限筆電使用；靜音不會改變這項限制。

options.text: To turn the slides into a recorded video.
options.zh: 把投影片製作成預錄影片。
options.whyZh: 對話是在安排即時展示和聲音來源，沒有提到要把投影片錄成影片。

questions.explanationZh: 男方請她只使用現場電腦處理聲音，明確說這是為了避免回音。
questions.evidence: Use the room computer for sound so we don’t hear an echo.

evidenceSpans.speaker: M
evidenceSpans.exactQuote: Use the room computer for sound so we don’t hear an echo.

vocabulary.note: 同一房間若有兩台裝置同時收音及播放，與會者可能會重複聽到同一段聲音。

questions.prompt: What is the woman’s immediate problem?
questions.promptZh: 女方目前遇到什麼問題？

options.text: She cannot remember which pool her class uses.
options.zh: 她不記得上課要用哪個游泳池。
options.whyZh: 她已上完課，而且問的是課後無法打開的置物櫃。

options.zh: 她沒有帶毛巾來游泳池。
options.whyZh: 她說毛巾在置物櫃裡，並非忘了帶。

options.text: She has lost her wristband.
options.zh: 她把腕帶弄丟了。
options.whyZh: 腕帶仍在，第二次也明確表示自己還帶著。

options.text: Her wristband no longer opens the locker.
options.zh: 她的腕帶現在打不開置物櫃。
options.whyZh: 女方說腕帶上課前能開櫃，但下課後就不能用了。

questions.evidence: My wristband opened a locker before my lesson, but it isn’t working now.

vocabulary.note: 此處指可感應開啟置物櫃的腕帶。

questions.prompt: If the attendant cannot read the existing band, what will he ask the woman to do?
questions.promptZh: 如果服務員讀不到現有的腕帶，會請女方做什麼？

options.text: Describe the items inside the locker.
options.zh: 描述置物櫃裡的物品。
options.whyZh: 男方說讀不到腕帶時，會在開櫃前先請她描述櫃內物品。

options.text: Give the name of her swimming instructor.
options.zh: 提供游泳教練的姓名。
options.whyZh: 開啟置物櫃的步驟沒有提到教練姓名。

options.text: Wait for another person to empty the locker.
options.zh: 等其他人把置物櫃清空。
options.whyZh: 服務員要她先描述物品，沒有要求別人代清。

options.text: Return in the evening with a replacement band.
options.zh: 晚上帶替換腕帶回來。
options.whyZh: 他要她現在取走物品，不是換腕帶後晚上才來開原櫃。

questions.explanationZh: 男方說讀不到腕帶時，會在開櫃前先請她描述櫃內物品。
questions.evidence: If the band can’t be read, I’ll ask you to describe what is in the locker before I open it.

evidenceSpans.exactQuote: If the band can’t be read, I’ll ask you to describe what is in the locker before I open it.

vocabulary.term: describe what is in the locker

questions.prompt: Which plan matches what the man says about both sessions?
questions.promptZh: 哪項安排符合男方對兩個時段的說明？

options.text: Leave the towel in the same locker and exchange bands when she returns.
options.zh: 把毛巾留在原來的置物櫃，回來時再換腕帶。

options.whyZh: 那時馬達已關閉，所以不是測試期間的轉速改變。

options.text: The stand striking the floor during transport.
options.zh: 搬運時支架撞到地板。
options.whyZh: 女方只提到機體被從支架抬起，並未提到支架撞地。

options.text: A new unit being switched on.
options.zh: 有一台新機體被開啟。
options.whyZh: 談到的是原機體的馬達關閉後被移開，不是另一台被開啟。

options.text: The unit being lifted off its stand.
options.zh: 機體被抬離支架。
options.whyZh: 女方說尖峰出現在馬達關閉後，是把機體抬離支架時造成的，不是馬達運轉造成的。

questions.explanationZh: 女方說尖峰出現在馬達關閉後，是把機體抬離支架時造成的，不是馬達運轉造成的。
questions.evidence: Check the grey band on the chart. It marks the time after we switched the motor off. That spike is from lifting the unit off the stand, not from running the motor.

evidenceSpans.speaker: F
evidenceSpans.exactQuote: Check the grey band on the chart. It marks the time after we switched the motor off. That spike is from lifting the unit off the stand, not from running the motor.

vocabulary.note: lift the unit off the stand 表示把機體完全抬離支架。

questions.prompt: How should the man present the results?
questions.promptZh: 男方應如何呈現結果？

options.text: Remove everything that happened after the shutoff.
options.zh: 刪去關機後的全部資料。
options.whyZh: 男方提出裁掉，但女方要求保留整張圖。

options.text: Keep the whole chart, explain the grey band and mark the largest spike before it.
options.zh: 保留整張圖、解釋灰色區段，並標出它之前的最大尖峰。
options.whyZh: 女方指定要保留圖表、加註灰色帶，並圈出運轉區段的最大尖峰。

options.text: Keep the chart but circle the largest spike on the far right.
options.zh: 保留圖表，但圈出最右側的最大尖峰。
options.whyZh: 最右的尖峰不是運轉資料，該圈的是灰色帶左側的尖峰。

options.text: Replace the chart with written notes and show no data.
options.zh: 用文字替代圖表，不顯示資料。
options.whyZh: 女方請他把註解加在圖表上，並沒有要求取消圖表。

questions.explanationZh: 女方指定要保留圖表、加註灰色帶，並圈出運轉區段的最大尖峰。

Add a note explaining the grey band, and circle the largest spike to the left of it.

evidenceSpans.exactQuote: Should I crop the chart at the motor shutoff, so the customer doesn’t have to see the grey band?

questions.prompt: Why can’t the woman identify her mug by looking for its paper label?
questions.promptZh: 女方為何不能靠紙標辨認自己的杯子？

options.text: Two members used the same paper label.
options.zh: 兩位學員用了相同的紙標。
options.whyZh: 紙標在燒製前已移除，並非重複使用相同標籤。

options.text: All the mugs were painted a different color.
options.zh: 每個杯子都上了不同顏色。
options.whyZh: 領取架上至少有兩個藍杯，顏色並非紙標不見的原因。

options.text: Paper labels are taken off before firing.
options.zh: 紙標在燒製前會拿掉。
options.whyZh: 男方直接說進窯前會撕掉紙標。

options.text: The labels were moved to the repair shelf.
options.zh: 紙標被移到維修架。
options.whyZh: 維修架是放待修杯子的地方，沒有搬移紙標的說法。

questions.explanationZh: 男方直接說進窯前會撕掉紙標。
questions.evidence: I’m collecting the blue mug I made at the weekend class. The pickup shelf has two blue mugs, but the paper label I put on mine is missing. / We take paper labels off before firing. Look underneath. Each member pressed a different stamp into the clay. The stamp should still be visible.

evidenceSpans.speaker: F
evidenceSpans.exactQuote: I’m collecting the blue mug I made at the weekend class. The pickup shelf has two blue mugs, but the paper label I put on mine is missing.

evidenceSpans.speaker: M
evidenceSpans.exactQuote: We take paper labels off before firing. Look underneath. Each member pressed a different stamp into the clay. The stamp should still be visible.

vocabulary.note: firing 在陶藝指用窯燒製陶器。

questions.prompt: What indicates which mug is hers?
questions.promptZh: 什麼能辨識哪個是她的杯子？

options.text: A triangular mark on its underside.
options.zh: 杯底的三角形印記。
options.whyZh: 男方請她看杯底印記，她認出自己的小三角形。

options.text: Its blue color alone.
options.zh: 光看杯子的藍色。
options.whyZh: 兩個杯子都是藍色，不能只靠顏色。

options.text: The fact that its handle is completely smooth.
options.zh: 杯把完全光滑。
options.whyZh: 她的杯把摸起來有點粗。

options.text: A new paper tag already on its handle.
options.zh: 杯把上已掛著的新紙標。
options.whyZh: 新紙標是在送修時才附上，不是領件時的辨識方式。

questions.explanationZh: 男方請她看杯底印記，她認出自己的小三角形。
questions.evidence: We take paper labels off before firing. Look underneath. Each member pressed a different stamp into the clay. The stamp should still be visible. / One has my little triangle, but its handle feels rough. Can I take it home and bring it back next week?

evidenceSpans.speaker: M
evidenceSpans.exactQuote: We take paper labels off before firing. Look underneath. Each member pressed a different stamp into the clay. The stamp should still be visible.

evidenceSpans.speaker: F
evidenceSpans.exactQuote: One has my little triangle, but its handle feels rough. Can I take it home and bring it back next week?

vocabulary.note: 在此指查看杯底的印記。

questions.prompt: What should she do if she wants the handle fixed?
questions.promptZh: 如果她想修好杯把，應該怎麼做？

options.text: Take the mug home and return next week without leaving any details.
options.zh: 把杯子帶回家，下週再來，不留聯絡資料。
options.whyZh: 她問能否下週再拿來，但男方要求今天留在維修架並寫電話，未說她打算不留聯絡資料。

options.text: Put the mug back on the general pickup shelf.
options.zh: 把杯子放回一般領取架。
options.whyZh: 男方指定維修架，不是領取架。

options.text: Leave both blue mugs so the studio can pick one to repair.
options.zh: 兩個藍杯都留下，請工作室選一個修。
options.whyZh: 她已確認自己的杯子，不須交出另一人的杯子。

options.text: Leave her mug on the repair shelf with a new contact tag.
options.zh: 把她的杯子留在維修架，附上寫有聯絡資料的新標籤。
options.whyZh: 男方要求今天留下她的杯子，附新紙標並寫電話。

questions.explanationZh: 男方要求今天留下她的杯子，附新紙標並寫電話。
questions.evidence: One has my little triangle, but its handle feels rough. Can I take it home and bring it back next week? / If you want us to smooth the handle, leave it on the repair shelf today. Write your phone number on a new paper tag, so we can contact you when it’s ready.

evidenceSpans.speaker: F
evidenceSpans.exactQuote: One has my little triangle, but its handle feels rough. Can I take it home and bring it back next week?

evidenceSpans.speaker: M
evidenceSpans.exactQuote: If you want us to smooth the handle, leave it on the repair shelf today. Write your phone number on a new paper tag, so we can contact you when it’s ready.

vocabulary.note: 在此用來留下聯絡電話，不是燒製前的識別紙標。

questions.prompt: Which finding in the visitor’s PDF supports the man’s explanation rather than the woman’s?
questions.promptZh: 訪客手上的 PDF 裡，哪個情況能支持男方的解釋而非女方的猜測？

options.text: The index and diagram both show Rosa at Desk Five.
options.zh: 索引和平面圖都顯示羅莎在五號座位。
options.whyZh: 女方猜的是索引更改前的舊版本；兩頁都顯示舊號碼反而符合她的猜測，無法支持男方所說的兩頁不同步。

options.text: The diagram shows Rosa at Desk Five, but the visitor cannot find her entry in the index.
options.zh: 平面圖顯示羅莎在五號座位，但訪客在索引裡找不到她的資料。
options.whyZh: 平面圖的號碼符合男方的說法，但找不到索引資料就不知道訪客開的是不是已更新索引的版本。

options.text: The index lists Rosa at Desk Nine, but the diagram still shows her at Desk Five.
options.zh: 索引把羅莎列在九號座位，但平面圖仍顯示她在五號。
options.whyZh: 十一點已儲存新版索引，十一點四十分匯出，午餐後才改平面圖，而且修改原始檔不會回寫既有 PDF。因此只有索引更新、平面圖仍停在舊號碼，最符合男方解釋。

options.text: The index and diagram both show Rosa at Desk Nine.
options.zh: 索引和平面圖都顯示羅莎在九號座位。
options.whyZh: 兩頁都是正確的新資料，無法解釋為何訪客依照圖上的標記走到五號。

questions.explanationZh: 要區分「開到更早的檔案」和「同一份 PDF 把新索引和舊平面圖一起匯出」，關鍵是查看同一份檔案中的兩頁是否一新一舊。
questions.evidence: I saved Desk Nine in the index at eleven yesterday. / We exported at eleven forty. I moved her map marker from Desk Five after lunch. Edits don’t change that PDF.

evidenceSpans.speaker: F
evidenceSpans.exactQuote: I saved Desk Nine in the index at eleven yesterday.

evidenceSpans.speaker: M
evidenceSpans.exactQuote: We exported at eleven forty. I moved her map marker from Desk Five after lunch. Edits don’t change that PDF.

vocabulary.note: 原始檔更新不會回寫已匯出的 PDF。

questions.prompt: Before sign-off, Communications asks to check Rosa’s name. The noon visitors need her signature in person and can’t wait until one. What can Communications and reception receive?
questions.promptZh: 核准前，公關部想核對羅莎的姓名。中午的訪客需要她當面簽名，又不能等到一點。公關部和接待櫃檯各可以收到什麼？

options.text: Send Communications the full line from the current index, and give reception a slip with the new desk number.
options.zh: 把目前索引的整列給公關部，並給櫃檯一張寫有新座位號碼的便條。
options.whyZh: 櫃檯可使用便條，但完整索引列包含核准前不能給公關部的座位號碼。

options.text: Send Communications the part of the current index line with Rosa’s name, and give reception a slip with the new desk number.
options.zh: 把索引目前那一列中的姓名部分給公關部，並給櫃檯一張寫有新座位號碼的便條。
options.whyZh: 核對姓名只需要那一部分；羅莎一點前留在樓上，訪客需要當面簽名、不能等，因此無法在櫃檯辦完，符合櫃檯可在核准前取得便條的例外。

options.text: Send Communications the part of the current index line with Rosa’s name, and leave the desk number off the counter slip until sign-off.
options.zh: 把索引目前那一列中的姓名部分給公關部，並在核准前不把座位號碼寫在櫃檯便條上。
options.whyZh: 公關部的資料範圍正確，但把限制錯套到接待櫃檯；訪客此時需要用新座位號碼上樓找人。

options.text: Send Communications the part of the current index line with Rosa’s name, and ask reception to get the document signed downstairs.
options.zh: 把索引目前那一列中的姓名部分給公關部，再請櫃檯在樓下安排文件簽名。
options.whyZh: 公關部的資料範圍正確，但羅莎一點前得留在樓上，訪客又不能等，因此請她在樓下簽名不符合已知條件。

questions.explanationZh: 這題要先從「須當面簽名」「一點前不能下樓」「訪客不能等」推得櫃檯無法代辦完成，再套用便條的例外；公關部仍只收到姓名。
questions.evidence: Rosa has to stay upstairs until one. / What can Communications see before Facilities approves the file? / Her name, not her desk number. If visitors can’t finish at reception, the counter can get the new number on a piece of paper until the new directory arrives.

evidenceSpans.speaker: M
evidenceSpans.exactQuote: Rosa has to stay upstairs until one.

evidenceSpans.speaker: F
evidenceSpans.exactQuote: What can Communications see before Facilities approves the file?

evidenceSpans.speaker: M
evidenceSpans.exactQuote: Her name, not her desk number. If visitors can’t finish at reception, the counter can get the new number on a piece of paper until the new directory arrives.

vocabulary.note: 核准前只能提供公關部所需姓名，接待櫃檯有例外。

questions.prompt: Reception is using a temporary slip. Approval comes at eleven twenty-five, the proof at eleven thirty, and printed directories arrive at twelve fifteen. When can the site and reception first use the replacement?
questions.promptZh: 接待櫃檯正在使用臨時便條。十一點二十五分核准、十一點三十分有校樣，印刷版名錄十二點十五分送達。網站和櫃檯各自最早何時可用新版？

options.text: The site and counter can both switch at eleven thirty, when the proof is available.
options.zh: 十一點三十分有校樣可供核對時，網站和櫃檯都可換新版。
options.whyZh: 網站不必等校樣，櫃檯也不能把內部校樣當作新版名錄。

options.text: The site can switch at eleven twenty-five, and the counter can switch at eleven thirty.
options.zh: 網站十一點二十五分可更換，櫃檯十一點三十分可更換。
options.whyZh: 網站時間正確，但十一點三十分只有內部校樣可供核對，正式印刷本尚未送達櫃檯。

options.text: The site can switch at eleven twenty-five, and the counter can switch at twelve fifteen.
options.zh: 網站十一點二十五分可更換，櫃檯十二點十五分可更換。
options.whyZh: 網站在設施管理部門核准後即可更新；櫃檯維持原便條，直到正式印刷本送到。

options.text: The site can switch at eleven thirty, and the counter can switch at twelve fifteen.
options.zh: 網站十一點三十分可更換，櫃檯十二點十五分可更換。
options.whyZh: 櫃檯時間正確，但網站可以在核准的十一點二十五分更新，不必多等五分鐘核對校樣。

questions.explanationZh: 區分三個時間點的作用：核准決定上網時間，校樣僅供內部檢查，正式印刷本送達才結束櫃檯使用便條的安排。
questions.evidence: until the new directory arrives. / Can we post the approved PDF before seeing the proof? / Yes. Print from that file, but keep the proof here.

evidenceSpans.speaker: M

evidenceSpans.speaker: F
evidenceSpans.exactQuote: Can we post the approved PDF before seeing the proof?
