evidenceSpans.exactQuote: Yes. Print from that file, but keep the proof here.

vocabulary.note: 校樣僅供內部核對，不等於正式印刷本。

questions.prompt: What did the woman already buy?
questions.promptZh: 女方已經買了什麼？

options.text: Two tags for bicycles.
options.zh: 兩張自行車掛牌。
options.whyZh: 女方才決定帶車，原先買的是步行乘客票。

options.text: A lock for each bicycle.
options.zh: 每輛自行車各一個鎖。
options.whyZh: 男方請他們把自行車鎖在停車架上，沒有說女方之前買了鎖。

options.text: Two seats on the eleven o’clock ferry.
options.zh: 十一點渡輪的兩個座位。
options.whyZh: 她買的是十點那班的乘客票，而不是十一點班次。

options.text: Two passenger tickets for the ten o’clock ferry.
options.zh: 十點渡輪的兩張乘客票。
options.whyZh: 女方開頭說買了兩張十點班次的步行乘客票。

questions.explanationZh: 女方開頭說買了兩張十點班次的步行乘客票。
questions.evidence: I bought two walk-on tickets for the ten o’clock ferry. We decided to bring our bicycles. Can we just show the same tickets at the ramp?

evidenceSpans.speaker: F
evidenceSpans.exactQuote: I bought two walk-on tickets for the ten o’clock ferry. We decided to bring our bicycles. Can we just show the same tickets at the ramp?

vocabulary.note: walk-on 指不搭載車輛而步行登船。

questions.prompt: Why can’t they bring both bicycles on the ten o’clock ferry?
questions.promptZh: 他們為什麼不能帶兩輛自行車搭十點的渡輪？

options.text: Only one bicycle tag remains for that departure.
options.zh: 該班次只剩一張自行車掛牌。
options.whyZh: 每台車需要一張掛牌，但十點班次只剩一張。

options.text: Both passenger tickets have expired.
options.zh: 兩張乘客票都已過期。
options.whyZh: 男方明說原先的乘客票依然有效。

options.text: The ramp is closed because of repairs.
options.zh: 登船坡道因維修關閉。
options.whyZh: 對話沒有談到坡道整修，限制是自行車掛牌的數量。

options.text: Bicycles are not permitted on any departures.
options.zh: 所有班次都不准帶自行車。
options.whyZh: 十一點那班可攜帶兩輛自行車，十點那班也仍有一張自行車掛牌。

questions.explanationZh: 每台車需要一張掛牌，但十點班次只剩一張。
questions.evidence: Your passenger tickets are still valid, but you need one bicycle tag for each bike. We’ve only got one tag left for that departure. The crossing takes twenty-five minutes. If you want to travel together with both bikes, the eleven o’clock ferry still has space.

evidenceSpans.speaker: M
evidenceSpans.exactQuote: Your passenger tickets are still valid, but you need one bicycle tag for each bike. We’ve only got one tag left for that departure. The crossing takes twenty-five minutes. If you want to travel together with both bikes, the eleven o’clock ferry still has space.

vocabulary.note: 每輛車各需一張，原有乘客票仍有效。

questions.prompt: Which plan lets them keep their meeting time and travel together?
questions.promptZh: 哪個方案讓他們一起搭船，又能準時與朋友碰面？

options.text: Bring both bicycles on the eleven o’clock ferry.
options.zh: 帶兩輛車搭十一點渡輪。
options.whyZh: 兩車雖可同搭，但十一點出發無法在十一點前和朋友會合。

options.text: Lock both bicycles beside the ticket office and board the ten o’clock ferry on foot.
options.zh: 把兩車鎖在售票處旁，步行搭十點那班。
options.whyZh: 車架能停兩部車，原本的乘客票有效；十點一起登船，二十五分鐘後就能抵達對岸。

options.text: Have one traveler take a bicycle at ten and the other travel later.
options.zh: 一人十點帶車搭船，另一人晚點搭。
options.whyZh: 兩人分開搭船，不符合一起出發的要求。

options.text: Buy two new passenger tickets at the ramp and keep both bicycles with them.
options.zh: 在坡道買兩張新乘客票並帶兩輛車搭船。
options.whyZh: 買新乘客票不會增加自行車掛牌，且原先的乘客票已能使用。

questions.explanationZh: 車架能停兩部車，原本的乘客票有效；十點一起登船，二十五分鐘後就能抵達對岸。

questions.prompt: Where should the workers collect the jackets they ordered?
questions.promptZh: 工作人員要到哪裡領取已訂的外套？
questions.evidence: If you are working at the exhibition this weekend, collect your jacket from the staff entrance on Friday.

evidenceSpans.speaker: M
evidenceSpans.exactQuote: If you are working at the exhibition this weekend, collect your jacket from the staff entrance on Friday.

options.text: At the delivery entrance.
options.zh: 在送貨入口。
options.whyZh: 錄音說領取地點是員工入口，沒有指定送貨入口。

options.text: At the staff entrance.
options.zh: 在員工入口。
options.whyZh: 開頭直接通知週五到員工入口領取外套。

options.text: Inside the exhibition hall.
options.zh: 在展覽會場內。
options.whyZh: 展覽是工作地點，通知並未把會場內列為領取地點。

options.text: At the fitting desk.
options.zh: 在試穿櫃檯。
options.whyZh: 試穿櫃檯處理更換尺寸，並非初次領取外套的地方。

questions.explanationZh: 開頭直接通知週五到員工入口領取外套。

vocabulary.note: 供工作人員進出的入口，不是一般訪客入口。

questions.prompt: What does a red tag on a jacket indicate?
questions.promptZh: 外套上的紅色標籤代表什麼？
questions.evidence: The jackets for the evening crew have red tags. / They are not spare jackets.

evidenceSpans.speaker: M
evidenceSpans.exactQuote: The jackets for the evening crew have red tags.

evidenceSpans.speaker: M
evidenceSpans.exactQuote: They are not spare jackets.

options.text: It needs to be sent back to the supplier.
options.zh: 這件外套需要退回給供應商。
options.whyZh: 紅標表示留給某個班別，並不代表外套要退回。

options.text: It has not yet been fitted with a name label.
options.zh: 這件外套還沒貼上姓名標籤。
options.whyZh: 有無姓名不是紅標的用途，紅標區分已保留的外套。

options.text: It can only be tried on at the staff entrance.
options.zh: 這件外套只能在員工入口試穿。
options.whyZh: 錄音沒有用紅標限制試穿地點，而說它已被保留。

options.text: It is being held for the evening crew.
options.zh: 這件外套已留給晚班人員。
options.whyZh: 錄音明確說紅標是晚班保留品，不是備用品。

questions.explanationZh: 錄音明確說紅標是晚班保留品，不是備用品。

vocabulary.note: 指額外備妥、可在需要時替換的物品。此處晚班外套不屬於這一類。

questions.prompt: What should a worker do if they need an extra-large jacket?
questions.promptZh: 工作人員如果需要 XL 尺寸的外套，應怎麼做？
questions.evidence: The fitting desk has a separate supply, but there are no jackets in size XL today. / If you need that size, leave your name. / We’ll check the next delivery on Saturday morning.

evidenceSpans.speaker: M
evidenceSpans.exactQuote: The fitting desk has a separate supply, but there are no jackets in size XL today.

evidenceSpans.speaker: M
evidenceSpans.exactQuote: If you need that size, leave your name.

evidenceSpans.speaker: M
evidenceSpans.exactQuote: We’ll check the next delivery on Saturday morning.

options.text: Take a red-tagged jacket for the day.
options.zh: 先拿一件紅標外套用一天。
options.whyZh: 紅標外套已留給晚班，不能當成備用尺寸拿取。

options.text: Wait at the staff entrance until a new jacket arrives Friday.
options.zh: 週五在員工入口等新的外套送到。
options.whyZh: 工作人員會在週六早上查看下一批到貨，不是要人在週五留在入口等。

options.text: Give their name so staff can check the next delivery.
options.zh: 留下姓名，讓工作人員查下一批到貨。
options.whyZh: 今天沒有加大尺寸備品，錄音請需要的人留下姓名，週六查貨。

options.text: Go directly to the delivery entrance and collect one.
options.zh: 直接到送貨入口領一件。
options.whyZh: 通知沒有要求自行去送貨入口，也沒有保證現在有加大尺寸。

questions.explanationZh: 今天沒有加大尺寸備品，錄音請需要的人留下姓名，週六查貨。

vocabulary.note: 指工作人員週六早上會查看的下一批貨。

questions.prompt: What does the host say about people who did not bring seeds?
questions.promptZh: 主持人對沒有帶種子的人怎麼說？
questions.evidence: You may take two, even if you did not bring seeds today.

evidenceSpans.speaker: F
evidenceSpans.exactQuote: You may take two, even if you did not bring seeds today.

options.text: They may still take two packets.
options.zh: 仍然可以拿兩袋種子。
options.whyZh: 一開始明確說即使沒帶種子也可以拿兩袋。

options.text: They must wait until the next event.
options.zh: 他們必須等到下次活動。
options.whyZh: 沒有帶種子不影響今天拿兩袋的資格。

options.text: They may only take blank envelopes.
options.zh: 他們只能拿空信封。
options.whyZh: 空信封另外放在出口，沒帶種子也能拿主桌種子袋。

options.text: They should volunteer at the check-in desk.
options.zh: 他們應在報到櫃檯當志工。
options.whyZh: 沒有帶種子的人不需要以擔任志工作為條件。

questions.explanationZh: 一開始明確說即使沒帶種子也可以拿兩袋。

vocabulary.note: 指用來裝種子的小紙袋或包裝。

questions.prompt: What should a visitor do with seeds brought from home?
questions.promptZh: 訪客應如何處理從家裡帶來的種子？
questions.evidence: If you bring seeds from your own garden, write the plant name and the month you collected them on the envelope. / Then leave it at the check-in desk, not on the table.

evidenceSpans.speaker: F
evidenceSpans.exactQuote: If you bring seeds from your own garden, write the plant name and the month you collected them on the envelope.

evidenceSpans.speaker: F
evidenceSpans.exactQuote: Then leave it at the check-in desk, not on the table.

options.text: Put the packet straight onto the main table.
options.zh: 直接把種子袋放到主桌。
options.whyZh: 主持人要求先交報到櫃檯，讓志工閱讀標示。

options.text: Write the variety only, then take the seeds to the exit.
options.zh: 只寫品種，再把種子拿到出口。
options.whyZh: 要填植物名稱和收集月份，出口是拿空信封的地方。

options.text: Leave the envelope blank and hand it to another visitor.
options.zh: 信封留白，交給另一位訪客。
options.whyZh: 需先標示名稱和月份，並交給報到櫃檯。

options.text: Label the envelope with the plant name and collection month, then leave it at check-in.
options.zh: 在信封上寫植物名稱和採集月份，再交到報到櫃檯。
options.whyZh: 通知要求先寫兩項資料，再將種子袋交到報到處。

questions.explanationZh: 通知要求先寫兩項資料，再將種子袋交到報到處。

vocabulary.note: 在這裡也是志工先查看種子標示的地方。

questions.prompt: What happens to a packet without a plant name?
questions.promptZh: 缺少植物名稱的種子袋將如何處理？
questions.evidence: When a plant name is missing, the packet goes into a separate box for later identification.

evidenceSpans.speaker: F
evidenceSpans.exactQuote: When a plant name is missing, the packet goes into a separate box for later identification.

options.text: It goes back on the main table immediately.
options.zh: 立刻放回主桌。
options.whyZh: 缺少名稱便需另行辨識，不會直接擺上交換桌。

options.text: It is returned to the visitor at the exit.
options.zh: 在出口退還給訪客。
options.whyZh: 出口是空信封的領取位置，沒有說在那裡退還種子。

options.text: It is put in a separate box for identification later.
options.zh: 另放在一個盒子裡，留待之後辨識。
options.whyZh: 錄音直接說缺名稱的種子袋會留在另一個盒子待辨識。

options.text: Its collection month is used as its plant name.
options.zh: 用採集月份當作植物名稱。
options.whyZh: 月份和名稱是兩個欄位，月份不會取代名稱。

questions.explanationZh: 錄音直接說缺名稱的種子袋會留在另一個盒子待辨識。

vocabulary.note: 這裡指辨認種子屬於哪種植物。

questions.prompt: What are the blue clips intended for?
questions.promptZh: 藍色卡扣的用途是什麼？

options.text: The next shipment.
options.zh: 下一批出貨。
options.whyZh: 錄音特別說藍色卡扣不作出貨用途。

options.text: The covered storage tray.
options.zh: 存放在有蓋托盤內。
options.whyZh: 有蓋托盤留給已核對的白色卡扣，不是藍色試裝品。

options.text: Today’s fit check.
options.zh: 今天的試裝。
options.whyZh: 主管一開始便說藍色卡扣是今天試裝用的。

options.text: Replacing unlabelled clips in the empty bin.
options.zh: 取代空料盒內沒有標籤的卡扣。
options.whyZh: 空料盒讓不明版本暫存，錄音沒有說用藍色卡扣取代它們。

questions.explanationZh: 主管一開始便說藍色卡扣是今天試裝用的。
questions.evidence: The blue clips are for today’s fit check, not for shipment.

evidenceSpans.speaker: M
evidenceSpans.exactQuote: The blue clips are for today’s fit check, not for shipment.

vocabulary.note: 試著裝入，確認尺寸或形狀能否配合。

questions.prompt: What does the speaker tell employees to do with a successful test result?
questions.promptZh: 錄音說，如果試裝成功，員工應該怎麼做？

options.text: Move an extra white clip to the empty bin.
options.zh: 把一個多餘的白卡扣移去空料盒。
options.whyZh: 空料盒留給沒有標籤的卡扣，白色仍放在有蓋托盤。

options.text: Record the result without mixing the clip into the covered tray.
options.zh: 登記結果，不要把藍色卡扣混入有蓋托盤。
options.whyZh: 主管指示記在工作表，而且不應把試裝用的藍卡扣放進有蓋托盤。

options.text: Send the blue clip directly to assembly.
options.zh: 直接把藍色卡扣送到組裝部門。
options.whyZh: 試裝結果需要記錄；未指示直接把藍色試裝品送組裝。

options.text: Remove its label and release it immediately.
options.zh: 撕掉標籤，立即放行。
options.whyZh: 需要先核對結果和列印機設定，不能因單次試裝就立刻放行。

questions.explanationZh: 主管指示記在工作表，而且不應把試裝用的藍卡扣放進有蓋托盤。
questions.evidence: If a blue clip fits, mark the result on the worksheet; do not swap it into the covered tray.

evidenceSpans.speaker: M
evidenceSpans.exactQuote: If a blue clip fits, mark the result on the worksheet; do not swap it into the covered tray.

vocabulary.note: 供記下測試或檢查結果的表格。

questions.prompt: What must happen before more clips are released?
questions.promptZh: 要再放行更多卡扣前，必須做什麼？

options.text: Compare the worksheet with the printer’s settings.
options.zh: 將工作表與列印機設定比對。
options.whyZh: 主管明確說，要核對工作表與設定，才可放行更多卡扣。

options.text: Paint the checked white clips blue.
options.zh: 把核對過的白色卡扣漆成藍色。
options.whyZh: 顏色是區分用途的標記，錄音沒有要求替零件改色。

options.text: Place all unlabelled clips in the covered tray.
options.zh: 把所有無標籤卡扣放入有蓋托盤。
options.whyZh: 無標籤的卡扣要先存放在空料盒，不能混進已核對品。

options.text: Ask assembly to discard everything on the shelf.
options.zh: 請組裝部門丟掉架上的所有物品。
options.whyZh: 整段說的是分類、登記與核對，不是丟掉架上所有物品。

questions.explanationZh: 主管明確說，要核對工作表與設定，才可放行更多卡扣。
questions.evidence: We need to compare the worksheet with the printer’s settings before we release any more clips.

evidenceSpans.speaker: M
evidenceSpans.exactQuote: We need to compare the worksheet with the printer’s settings before we release any more clips.

vocabulary.note: 允許經確認的零件進入下一道流程。

questions.prompt: What does the sign-out card list?
questions.promptZh: 借用登記卡列出什麼？

options.text: The names of the volunteers working today.
options.zh: 今天值班志工的名字。
options.whyZh: 卡上列的是工具名稱，沒有列出值班志工的名字。

options.text: The numbers of the common tables.
options.zh: 公用桌的編號。
options.whyZh: 公用桌只在說明剪刀位置時提到，卡並不列桌號。

options.text: Small items that may be taken home.
options.zh: 可帶回家的小工具。
options.whyZh: 錄音直接說卡上列出可以帶走的小工具。

options.text: Tools to be purchased next Saturday.
options.zh: 下週六要買的工具。
options.whyZh: 下週六是歸還時間，不是買工具的時間。

questions.explanationZh: 錄音直接說卡上列出可以帶走的小工具。
questions.evidence: The card lists the small items that can go home with you.

evidenceSpans.speaker: F
evidenceSpans.exactQuote: The card lists the small items that can go home with you.

vocabulary.note: 用來記錄哪些物品可借出或已借出。

questions.prompt: What should a visitor do with the long scissors before leaving?
questions.promptZh: 訪客離開前應如何處理長剪刀？

options.text: Add them to a home tool kit.
options.zh: 放進要帶回家的工具組。
options.whyZh: 公用桌的長剪刀不屬於工具組，不能帶離現場。

options.text: Put them in the supply drawer without telling anyone.
options.zh: 不必告知任何人，直接放進備品抽屜。
options.whyZh: 錄音說離開前交還志工；抽屜是替代物品的來源。

options.text: Keep them until next Saturday.
options.zh: 借到下週六再還。
options.whyZh: 下週六歸還規則只適用於可帶走的小工具。

options.text: Hand them back to a volunteer.
options.zh: 把剪刀交回志工。
options.whyZh: 剪刀可在現場用，但離開前要交還志工。

questions.explanationZh: 剪刀可在現場用，但離開前要交還志工。
questions.evidence: The long scissors on the common table are not part of any kit. / You may use them here, but hand them back to a volunteer before you go.

evidenceSpans.speaker: F
evidenceSpans.exactQuote: The long scissors on the common table are not part of any kit.

evidenceSpans.speaker: F
evidenceSpans.exactQuote: You may use them here, but hand them back to a volunteer before you go.

vocabulary.note: 把借用的物品還給原本保管的人。

questions.prompt: How should a broken item in a kit be handled?
questions.promptZh: 工具組裡有物品損壞時，該怎麼處理？

options.text: Write its name on the card and let a volunteer replace it.
options.zh: 在卡上寫品名，由志工換一件。
options.whyZh: 錄音要求先登記品名，由志工確認並提供替代品。

options.text: Buy a replacement and put it in the kit.
options.zh: 自行買替代品放入工具組。
options.whyZh: 錄音明確說不要自行更換，由志工拿備品。

options.text: Take the whole kit home without noting the damage.
options.zh: 不記錄損壞，把整組直接帶回家。
options.whyZh: 損壞品名稱要寫在卡上，不能略過。

options.text: Leave the broken item on the common table.
options.zh: 把損壞的物品留在公用桌。
options.whyZh: 公用桌的說明適用於長剪刀，損壞品要先填卡。

questions.explanationZh: 錄音要求先登記品名，由志工確認並提供替代品。
questions.evidence: If your kit contains a broken item, write its name on the card rather than replacing it yourself. / The volunteer will check the card and give you a replacement from the supply drawer.

evidenceSpans.speaker: F
evidenceSpans.exactQuote: If your kit contains a broken item, write its name on the card rather than replacing it yourself.

evidenceSpans.speaker: F
evidenceSpans.exactQuote: The volunteer will check the card and give you a replacement from the supply drawer.

vocabulary.note: 用來換掉原先損壞或無法使用的物品。

questions.prompt: What is the attendance list used for?
questions.promptZh: 出席名單用來做什麼？

options.text: Calculating overtime pay.
options.zh: 計算加班費。
options.whyZh: 出席名單不記錄工時，錄音沒有說要用它算加班費。

options.text: Confirming completion of the orientation.
options.zh: 確認是否完成入職訓練。
options.whyZh: 錄音直接說名單的用途是確認完成訓練。

options.text: Inviting more staff to register.
options.zh: 邀請更多員工報名。
options.whyZh: 通知是給已參加訓練的人，名單並不是邀請名單。

options.text: Replacing the normal timesheet.
options.zh: 取代一般工時表。
options.whyZh: 要填工時仍應使用一般工時表，不能以出席名單代替。

questions.explanationZh: 錄音直接說名單的用途是確認完成訓練。
questions.evidence: The list confirms completion of the training; it does not record hours worked.

evidenceSpans.speaker: M
evidenceSpans.exactQuote: The list confirms completion of the training; it does not record hours worked.

vocabulary.note: 列出參加特定活動或訓練的人員與出席情形。

questions.prompt: Someone attended in person in the morning and online in the afternoon. What should they see on the list?
questions.promptZh: 有人上午到場、下午在線上參加。名單上應列出什麼？

options.text: Only the first session.
options.zh: 只有第一個時段。
options.whyZh: 早上到場無法取代下午訓練的出席紀錄。

options.text: Only the afternoon session.
options.zh: 只有下午時段。
options.whyZh: 錄音要求確認早、下午都在名單上。

options.text: Both sessions.
options.zh: 兩個時段都列出。
options.whyZh: 針對上午到場、下午線上這種情況，通知明確要求列出兩個時段。

options.text: A separate registration for a third session.
options.zh: 額外報名的第三個時段。
options.whyZh: 通知只談上午與下午兩個時段，並沒有第三個。

questions.explanationZh: 針對上午到場、下午線上這種情況，通知明確要求列出兩個時段。
questions.evidence: If you joined the morning session in person and finished the afternoon session online, make sure the list shows both sessions.

evidenceSpans.speaker: M
evidenceSpans.exactQuote: If you joined the morning session in person and finished the afternoon session online, make sure the list shows both sessions.

vocabulary.note: 指本人在現場參加，而不是透過網路。

questions.prompt: What should staff do if their online session is missing from the list?
questions.promptZh: 如果自己的線上時段未列在名單上，員工應該怎麼做？

options.text: Add it in the registration system again.
options.zh: 回到報名系統重新加選。
options.whyZh: 錄音特別提醒不要重新加選缺漏時段。

options.text: Enter the session as overtime on the attendance list.
options.zh: 在出席名單上把該時段記成加班。
options.whyZh: 出席名單不登記工時，把時段記成加班也不能補登訓練出席。

options.text: Attend the whole orientation in person again.
options.zh: 重新到現場上完整訓練。
options.whyZh: 通知可用既有確認郵件核對，不要求重上課。

options.text: Send their confirmation email to the training desk.
options.zh: 把確認郵件寄到訓練櫃檯。
options.whyZh: 遇到線上紀錄漏列，應將原確認郵件交給訓練櫃檯。

questions.explanationZh: 遇到線上紀錄漏列，應將原確認郵件交給訓練櫃檯。
questions.evidence: Some online entries are still missing. / Please send your confirmation email to the training desk if that is the case.

evidenceSpans.speaker: M
evidenceSpans.exactQuote: Some online entries are still missing.

evidenceSpans.speaker: M
evidenceSpans.exactQuote: Please send your confirmation email to the training desk if that is the case.

vocabulary.note: 用於證明原來的報名或預約已獲確認。

questions.prompt: Why do staff ask for a visitor’s seat number?
questions.promptZh: 工作人員為什麼詢問訪客的座位號碼？
questions.evidence: Staff will ask for your seat number so they can bring a spare if yours stops working.

evidenceSpans.speaker: F
evidenceSpans.exactQuote: Staff will ask for your seat number so they can bring a spare if yours stops working.

options.text: So they can bring a replacement receiver if needed.
options.zh: 方便有需要時送來一台備用接收器。
options.whyZh: 錄音明確說記下座位是為了在接收器故障時送備用機。

options.text: So they can assign a different seat before admission.
options.zh: 方便入場前改派座位。
options.whyZh: 錄音並沒有說詢問座位是為了重新分配。

options.text: So they can start the recorded test at each seat.
options.zh: 方便在每個座位播放測試錄音。
options.whyZh: 測試訊息在入口桌播放，不需到座位才開始。

options.text: So they can close off some rows after the lecture.
options.zh: 方便在講座結束後封閉部分座位排。
options.whyZh: 講座後要歸還接收器，沒有封閉座位的安排。

questions.explanationZh: 錄音明確說記下座位是為了在接收器故障時送備用機。

vocabulary.note: 此處指接收器故障時可代替原機的另一台接收器。

questions.prompt: Which silence does the announcement describe as normal?
questions.promptZh: 公告說哪一種沒有聲音的情況是正常的？
questions.evidence: Once you sit down, the lecture channel will remain quiet until the host starts.

evidenceSpans.speaker: F
evidenceSpans.exactQuote: Once you sit down, the lecture channel will remain quiet until the host starts.

options.text: No sound at the entrance table during the receiver test.
options.zh: 在入口桌測試接收器時沒有聲音。
options.whyZh: 入口桌的測試本應播出錄音，聽不到就要回去處理。

options.text: No lecture sound at the seat before the host starts.
options.zh: 就座後，主持人開始前聽不到講座聲音。
options.whyZh: 就座後，主持人尚未開始時，講座頻道本來就會安靜。

options.text: A working receiver losing sound during the talk.
options.zh: 運作中的接收器在講座途中突然沒有聲音。
options.whyZh: 若使用中故障，工作人員可送來備用機，不是所說的正常安靜。

options.text: No sound after exchanging two receivers at the entrance.
options.zh: 在入口更換兩台接收器後仍沒有聲音。
options.whyZh: 錄音沒有說換兩台是流程；測試階段沒聲音仍應反映。

questions.explanationZh: 就座後，主持人尚未開始時，講座頻道本來就會安靜。

vocabulary.note: 在這裡指主持人開始前，講座頻道還沒有播出聲音。

questions.prompt: What should a visitor do with a receiver that works after the lecture?
questions.promptZh: 講座結束後，訪客該如何處理運作正常的接收器？
questions.evidence: At the end, put working receivers in the blue tray and report any problem to the volunteer beside it.

evidenceSpans.speaker: F
evidenceSpans.exactQuote: At the end, put working receivers in the blue tray and report any problem to the volunteer beside it.

options.text: Keep it for the next lecture.
options.zh: 留著下次講座再用。
options.whyZh: 講座結束後需要歸還接收器，不應自行保留。

options.text: Leave it on the seat.
options.zh: 留在座位上。
options.whyZh: 通知指定要放進藍色托盤，沒有說留在座位。

options.text: Put it in the blue tray.
options.zh: 放進藍色托盤。
options.whyZh: 最後一句明確指定正常運作的接收器放到藍色托盤。

options.text: Take it to another room to test again.
options.zh: 拿到另一個房間再測試。
options.whyZh: 測試是在入場前，正常使用完後可依指示放回藍盤。

questions.explanationZh: 最後一句明確指定正常運作的接收器放到藍色托盤。

vocabulary.note: 此處描述接收器功能正常，不是指有人正在工作。

questions.prompt: Which part of the program does the event team still need to check?
questions.promptZh: 活動團隊還要檢查節目冊的哪個部分？
questions.evidence: The event team needs to check where the fold falls on the room map.

evidenceSpans.speaker: M
evidenceSpans.exactQuote: The event team needs to check where the fold falls on the room map.

options.text: The position of a fold on the room map.
options.zh: 會場平面圖上的折線位置。
options.whyZh: 要確認平面圖的折線位置；文字已核准，重點是實際裝訂的效果。

options.text: The spelling of every name in the text.
options.zh: 文字中所有人名的拼法。
options.whyZh: 錄音說文字已核准，這次要檢查的是折線。

options.text: The binding station’s opening hours.
options.zh: 裝訂區的開放時間。
options.whyZh: 整批留在裝訂區，不代表活動團隊要查它的開放時間。

options.text: The number of copies the print room ordered.
options.zh: 印務室訂購的本數。
options.whyZh: 只提到先送一本成品，沒有說這次審查是核對訂購本數。

questions.explanationZh: 要確認平面圖的折線位置；文字已核准，重點是實際裝訂的效果。

vocabulary.note: 在這裡指實體冊子摺起來的位置。

questions.prompt: How should the finished sample be left at reception?
questions.promptZh: 成品樣本送到接待櫃檯時，應該怎麼放？
questions.evidence: When you deliver the copy, open it to the map page and leave a removable slip, not a mark on the paper.

evidenceSpans.speaker: M
evidenceSpans.exactQuote: When you deliver the copy, open it to the map page and leave a removable slip, not a mark on the paper.

options.text: Draw an arrow on the map.
options.zh: 直接在平面圖上畫一個箭頭。
options.whyZh: 錄音說不要在紙面直接留下記號。

options.text: Put a permanent mark on the folded edge.
options.zh: 在折邊留下永久的記號。
options.whyZh: 標示需要可取下，不是留下永久記號。

options.text: Open it to the map and leave a slip that can be removed.
options.zh: 翻到平面圖並放上一張可取下的紙條。
options.whyZh: 印務人員要求把成品翻到平面圖那頁，採用可移除的紙條。

options.text: Attach the approval note to the back cover.
options.zh: 把核准備註貼在封底。
options.whyZh: 講者說要翻到平面圖並放一張可取下的紙條，沒提到把核准備註貼在封底。

questions.explanationZh: 印務人員要求把成品翻到平面圖那頁，採用可移除的紙條。

vocabulary.note: 用來暫時標記頁面，取下後不會在紙上留下記號。

questions.prompt: If the team asks for more space along the fold, what should happen first?
questions.promptZh: 如果團隊要求折線旁增加空間，第一步應怎麼做？
questions.evidence: If they ask for a wider fold margin, bring that copy back to me. / Don’t change the layout until we’ve measured how much space they need.

evidenceSpans.speaker: M
evidenceSpans.exactQuote: If they ask for a wider fold margin, bring that copy back to me.

evidenceSpans.speaker: M
evidenceSpans.exactQuote: Don’t change the layout until we’ve measured how much space they need.

options.text: Change the layout before returning the sample.
options.zh: 先改版面再退回樣本。
options.whyZh: 錄音明確禁止先改版面，須先量所需空間。

options.text: Return the sample so the needed space can be measured.
options.zh: 把樣本送回，以便量出所需的空間。
options.whyZh: 對方要求加寬時，先帶回同一本，再量所需空間，之後才能改版。

options.text: Send the entire batch to reception for review.
options.zh: 把整批送到接待區審查。
options.whyZh: 檢查用的是一本成品，整批仍暫留裝訂區。

options.text: Print a new map without any fold.
options.zh: 重印一張完全沒有折線的平面圖。
options.whyZh: 要求是查明加寬的空間，並非取消折頁。

questions.explanationZh: 對方要求加寬時，先帶回同一本，再量所需空間，之後才能改版。

vocabulary.note: 與折線相鄰、可以調整的空白區。

questions.prompt: Where should customers collect a prepaid order today?
questions.promptZh: 今天已付款的預訂品應到哪裡領？
questions.evidence: all prepaid orders will be at the covered pickup counter beside the main gate.

evidenceSpans.speaker: F
evidenceSpans.exactQuote: all prepaid orders will be at the covered pickup counter beside the main gate.

options.text: At each stall in the order.
options.zh: 到這筆訂單涉及的各個攤位。
options.whyZh: 因下雨改到同一個取貨櫃檯，不需在各攤排隊。

options.text: Just beyond the last row of stalls.
options.zh: 剛過最後一排攤位的地方。
options.whyZh: 通知指定在主入口旁，沒有說要走過最後一排攤位。

options.text: At the counter where new purchases are paid for.
options.zh: 在新購品付款的櫃檯。
options.whyZh: 主入口旁的取貨櫃檯不收新購品的款項。

options.text: At the covered counter by the main gate.
options.zh: 在主入口旁有遮蔽的櫃檯。
options.whyZh: 錄音直接說已付款的預訂品全都移到主入口旁的取貨櫃檯。

questions.explanationZh: 錄音直接說已付款的預訂品全都移到主入口旁的取貨櫃檯。

vocabulary.note: 先支付後領取的訂單。

questions.prompt: Why should customers still look at the stall number in their message?
questions.promptZh: 顧客為何仍要看訊息裡的攤位號碼？
questions.evidence: Stall numbers in your order message are still useful; read yours to the volunteer there so she can find the right bag.

evidenceSpans.speaker: F
evidenceSpans.exactQuote: Stall numbers in your order message are still useful; read yours to the volunteer there so she can find the right bag.

options.text: They must transfer their payment to that stall.
options.zh: 他們須把款項轉到那攤。
options.whyZh: 這些預訂品早已付費，通知並不是要求再付款。

options.text: It helps the volunteer locate the correct bag.
options.zh: 它能協助志工找到正確的袋子。
options.whyZh: 顧客把號碼念給志工，是為了讓志工找到正確的預訂品。

options.text: It identifies a separate outdoor line.
options.zh: 它指出戶外另一條隊伍。
options.whyZh: 不用依攤位分開排隊，號碼是給取貨志工查找用的。

options.text: They need it to buy something without an order.
options.zh: 未預訂的商品也必須用該號碼購買。
options.whyZh: 新購品直接到攤位，通知沒有要求提供既有訂單的攤位號碼。

questions.explanationZh: 顧客把號碼念給志工，是為了讓志工找到正確的預訂品。

vocabulary.note: 用於辨認是哪一攤提供的預訂品。

questions.prompt: What can staff do if a customer cannot find an earlier order?
questions.promptZh: 如果顧客找不到先前的訂單，工作人員可以做什麼？
questions.evidence: The counter can check a missing order, but it cannot accept payments for new purchases.

evidenceSpans.speaker: F
evidenceSpans.exactQuote: The counter can check a missing order, but it cannot accept payments for new purchases.

options.text: Check for that missing order.
options.zh: 查找那筆找不到的訂單。
options.whyZh: 最後一句說可以查找不到的訂單，但不能收新購品的款項。

options.text: Accept payment to open a replacement order.
options.zh: 收款並另外開一筆替代訂單。
options.whyZh: 該櫃檯不能收新訂單付款，工作是查既有訂單。

options.text: Order an item from another market.
options.zh: 替顧客向另一個市集訂購。
options.whyZh: 錄音沒有提供向其他市集訂購的服務。

options.text: Direct every customer to the individual stalls first.
options.zh: 先把每個顧客都轉送到各攤位。
options.whyZh: 已付款的預訂品原本就到櫃檯處理，不必先去各攤。

questions.explanationZh: 最後一句說可以查找不到的訂單，但不能收新購品的款項。

vocabulary.note: 在這裡指已預訂，現場卻未能找到的項目。

questions.prompt: Which catalogue should staff open during the demonstration?
questions.promptZh: 示範時員工應開啟哪個目錄？
questions.evidence: For the training demo, open the sample catalogue, not the one our customers use.

evidenceSpans.speaker: M
evidenceSpans.exactQuote: For the training demo, open the sample catalogue, not the one our customers use.

options.text: The one currently used by customers.
options.zh: 目前客戶使用的那個目錄。
options.whyZh: 講者明確排除客戶版；用的是訓練範例。

options.text: The sample catalogue.
options.zh: 範例目錄。
options.whyZh: 錄音開頭即指定要使用訓練用的範例目錄。

options.text: A printed stock report from the media team.
options.zh: 媒體團隊的紙本庫存報告。
options.whyZh: 媒體團隊負責補圖，示範沒有使用庫存報告。

options.text: A new catalogue created separately for each participant.
options.zh: 為每位參加者各自新建的目錄。
options.whyZh: 錄音要求用既有範例，沒有要求個別建立目錄。

questions.explanationZh: 錄音開頭即指定要使用訓練用的範例目錄。

vocabulary.note: 列出商品及相關資料的頁面或資料庫。

questions.prompt: What does a grey picture indicate in the sample catalogue?
questions.promptZh: 範例目錄中的灰色圖片表示什麼？
questions.evidence: A grey picture means the image file is not on this tablet. / It does not mean the product is unavailable.

evidenceSpans.speaker: M
evidenceSpans.exactQuote: A grey picture means the image file is not on this tablet.

evidenceSpans.speaker: M
evidenceSpans.exactQuote: It does not mean the product is unavailable.

options.text: The product is no longer sold.
options.zh: 商品已停售。
options.whyZh: 講者明說該狀態不是指商品無貨或不能供應。

options.text: The tablet has no sample stock figures.
options.zh: 平板沒有任何庫存範例數字。
options.whyZh: 圖片狀態與庫存數字分開，範例數字確實有提到。

options.text: The product has just been reserved by a customer.
options.zh: 商品剛被客戶預訂。
options.whyZh: 示範目錄與實際客戶使用的目錄不同，灰圖也不表示預訂。

options.text: The image file is missing from this tablet.
options.zh: 這台平板缺少該圖片檔。
options.whyZh: 灰圖表示這台平板上沒有該圖片檔。

questions.explanationZh: 灰圖表示這台平板上沒有該圖片檔。

vocabulary.note: 在這裡講者明確否定灰圖表示商品無法供應。

questions.prompt: What should staff send to the media team after class?
questions.promptZh: 下課後員工應把什麼寄給媒體團隊？
questions.evidence: After class, note which picture was grey and send the product code to our media team.

evidenceSpans.speaker: M
evidenceSpans.exactQuote: After class, note which picture was grey and send the product code to our media team.

options.text: A promise to stock the item before next class.
options.zh: 下堂課以前補足庫存的承諾。
options.whyZh: 範例資料只供訓練，不能據此承諾有貨。

options.text: A screenshot of every product with training numbers.
options.zh: 每個商品和範例數字的畫面截圖。
options.whyZh: 只需針對缺圖的商品回報代碼，並非擷取所有畫面。

options.text: The code of the product whose image is grey.
options.zh: 圖片呈灰色的商品代碼。
options.whyZh: 請記錄哪張圖呈灰色，再把該商品代碼寄給媒體團隊補圖。

options.text: A list of customers whose catalogue would not load.
options.zh: 目錄無法載入的客戶名單。
options.whyZh: 講者談的是範例目錄的本機圖片，並非客戶登入或瀏覽情況。

questions.explanationZh: 請記錄哪張圖呈灰色，再把該商品代碼寄給媒體團隊補圖。

vocabulary.note: 用來在檔案目錄中辨認特定產品。

questions.prompt: How many lists should one household send?
questions.promptZh: 每戶應提交幾份名單？
questions.evidence: Please send us one list per household by tonight.

evidenceSpans.speaker: F
evidenceSpans.exactQuote: Please send us one list per household by tonight.

options.text: A separate list for each member.
options.zh: 每位家人各交一份。
options.whyZh: 規定是每戶一份，不是按家人數目分開提交。

options.text: One for each place they visited.
options.zh: 去過的每個地點各交一份。
options.whyZh: 只收池塘步道的紀錄，名單份數以每戶一份計。

options.text: Two, if the household saw the same bird together.
options.zh: 如果家人一起看到同一隻鳥就交兩份。
options.whyZh: 同一隻鳥只能記一次，也不需要因此多交一份。

options.text: One.
options.zh: 一份。
options.whyZh: 講者一開始明確說每戶交一份名單。

questions.explanationZh: 講者一開始明確說每戶交一份名單。

vocabulary.note: 以同住的一戶人作為提交單位。

questions.prompt: Which observation should be excluded from the list?
questions.promptZh: 哪一筆觀察不應列入名單？
questions.evidence: We want reports from the pond path, not from the feeding table in the visitor center.

evidenceSpans.speaker: F
evidenceSpans.exactQuote: We want reports from the pond path, not from the feeding table in the visitor center.

options.text: A bird seen at the feeding table inside the visitor center.
options.zh: 在遊客中心裡的餵食台看到的鳥。
options.whyZh: 領隊指定只收池塘步道紀錄，明確排除遊客中心餵食台。

options.text: A bird seen on the pond path during the count.
options.zh: 計數期間在池塘步道看到的鳥。
options.whyZh: 指定收錄池塘步道在這次計數活動中的觀察。

options.text: A bird seen on the pond path for which no photo was taken.
options.zh: 池塘步道上看到但沒有拍照的鳥。
options.whyZh: 照片不是必要條件，即使沒有照片也能提交紀錄。

options.text: One entry for a bird that two household members saw together on the path.
options.zh: 同戶兩個人在步道一起看到同一隻鳥，只記了一筆。
options.whyZh: 一起看到同一隻鳥正應只記一次，這一筆可以列入。

questions.explanationZh: 領隊指定只收池塘步道紀錄，明確排除遊客中心餵食台。

vocabulary.note: 讓鳥類取食的一個平台；題中位於不列入的區域。

questions.prompt: What should someone write when they cannot identify a bird?
questions.promptZh: 無法辨認某隻鳥時，應記下什麼？
questions.evidence: If you could not identify a bird, write its size and where you saw it. / Do not guess the species.

evidenceSpans.speaker: F
evidenceSpans.exactQuote: If you could not identify a bird, write its size and where you saw it.

evidenceSpans.speaker: F
evidenceSpans.exactQuote: Do not guess the species.

options.text: The species they think is most likely.
options.zh: 自己猜測最可能的種類。
options.whyZh: 領隊明確說應記下看到的特徵，不要猜種類。

options.text: Only its location, with no other details.
options.zh: 只寫地點，不寫其他資料。
options.whyZh: 應同時記大小及看到的位置，不只有地點。

options.text: Its size and the place where it was seen.
options.zh: 牠的大小及看到牠的地點。
options.whyZh: 種類不明時，講者明確要求填大小和地點，避免猜測。

options.text: The names of every volunteer in the group.
options.zh: 同組每位志工的名字。
options.whyZh: 講者要的是鳥的大小和觀察地點，沒有要求列出志工姓名。

questions.explanationZh: 種類不明時，講者明確要求填大小和地點，避免猜測。

vocabulary.note: 辨認不確定時，不必猜測是哪一種鳥。

questions.prompt: The staff entrance has no space for a delivery cart. Please leave the cartons by the loading door _____ the night crew can move them inside without blocking anyone.
questions.promptZh: 員工入口沒有地方停放送貨推車。請把紙箱留在卸貨門旁，_____ 夜班人員能在不擋到他人的情況下把貨搬進室內。

options.text: even though
options.zh: 雖然
options.whyZh: 表示讓步，需要與預期相反的情況；後半句是放置紙箱的目的，不是障礙。

options.text: so that
options.zh: 好讓
options.whyZh: so that 加主詞和動詞表示目的：選擇卸貨門是為了讓夜班人員把紙箱搬進室內，又不擋到他人。

options.text: as if
options.zh: 好像
options.whyZh: 引導表面看來的情況或假設；此處說的是實際安排的目的，不是裝出能搬貨的樣子。

options.text: now that
options.zh: 既然
options.whyZh: 後接已成立的原因；夜班後續可以順利搬貨是預期結果，不是已發生的前提。

questions.explanationZh: so that 加主詞和動詞表示目的：選擇卸貨門是為了讓夜班人員把紙箱搬進室內，又不擋到他人。
questions.evidence: The staff entrance has no space for a delivery cart. Please leave the cartons by the loading door so that the night crew can move them inside without blocking anyone.

vocabulary.note: 這裡指貨物進出的專用大門。

questions.prompt: The print shop does not offer cash refunds for photographs, but prints with visible defects are _____ for a free reprint if the original receipt is shown.
questions.promptZh: 相片沖印店不為相片退現金，但若相片有肉眼可見的瑕疵且能出示原始收據，就 _____ 免費重印的資格。

options.text: ineligible
options.zh: 不具備
options.whyZh: ineligible 表示不能取得該服務，與滿足瑕疵及收據兩項重印條件時可以免費重印相反。

options.text: responsible
options.zh: 負責的
options.whyZh: responsible for 須指出誰負責，有瑕疵的相片本身不是執行重印的人。

options.text: eligible
options.zh: 具備
options.whyZh: eligible for 表示符合取得服務的條件，兩個必要條件是可見瑕疵與原始收據。

options.text: grateful
options.zh: 感激的
options.whyZh: grateful 表示某人心懷感激；相片本身不會感到感激。

questions.explanationZh: eligible for 表示符合取得服務的條件，兩個必要條件是可見瑕疵與原始收據。
questions.evidence: The print shop does not offer cash refunds for photographs, but prints with visible defects are eligible for a free reprint if the original receipt is shown.

vocabulary.note: reprint 可作名詞，指重新印製的成品或重印服務。

questions.prompt: The two lids fit the same jars and seal equally well. Either lid can replace the other without changing how the jar is used, so the lids are _____.
questions.promptZh: 兩種蓋子都適用於同一批罐子，而且密封效果一樣。兩者可互換，不影響罐子的用法，所以這兩種蓋子是 _____。

options.text: interchangeable
options.zh: 可互換的
options.whyZh: either lid can replace the other 說的是任一個可替代另一個，正是 interchangeable。

options.text: disposable
options.zh: 用完可丟的
options.whyZh: 沒有說蓋子只能使用一次或應該丟掉，句子重點是可替代性。

options.text: perishable
options.zh: 易腐壞的
options.whyZh: 文中沒有保存期限或腐敗情形，且密封用途不等於易腐。

options.text: adjustable
options.zh: 可調整的
options.whyZh: 蓋子可互換不代表其尺寸或結構可以調整，句中沒有任何調整動作。

questions.explanationZh: either lid can replace the other 說的是任一個可替代另一個，正是 interchangeable。
questions.evidence: The two lids fit the same jars and seal equally well. Either lid can replace the other without changing how the jar is used, so the lids are interchangeable.

vocabulary.note: equally well 比較兩者同一項表現。

questions.prompt: The small theater _____ closed for repairs since Monday, and it will not reopen until the new seats are installed.
questions.promptZh: 這間小劇院從星期一開始就 _____ 關閉整修的狀態，要等座椅換好才會重新開放。

options.text: was
options.zh: 過去是
options.whyZh: 單純過去式不能在本句自然表達自星期一起持續到現在且目前仍持續的關閉狀態。

options.text: would be
options.zh: 將會是（過去觀點）
options.whyZh: would be 表示過去觀點的未來或假設，無法承接 since Monday 至今持續關閉。

options.text: is being
options.zh: 目前正在被
options.whyZh: is being closed 說的是關閉動作正在進行，不是 since Monday 一直關閉的狀態。

options.text: has been
options.zh: 一直處於
options.whyZh: since Monday 標出起點，現在仍關閉用現在完成式 has been closed。

questions.explanationZh: since Monday 標出起點，現在仍關閉用現在完成式 has been closed。
questions.evidence: The small theater has been closed for repairs since Monday, and it will not reopen until the new seats are installed.

vocabulary.note: re- 表示再次，這裡說劇院重新對外開放。

questions.prompt: The first dashboard reports the number of support tickets. The second reports the average response time. On the summary slide, these two dashboards are labeled “Volume” and “Speed,” _____.
questions.promptZh: 第一個儀表板顯示客服單數量，第二個顯示平均回覆時間。在摘要投影片中，兩個儀表板 _____ 標為「量」與「速度」。

options.text: collectively
options.zh: 合在一起
options.whyZh: 兩個標籤各有一個對象，不是把儀表板合在一起用一個共同標籤。

options.text: alternately
options.zh: 輪流地
options.whyZh: 句子內已有既定的第一、第二與兩個固定標籤，不是在不同時間輪換名稱。

options.text: respectively
options.zh: 按列出順序分別
options.whyZh: 第一項數量對應 Volume，第二項時間對應 Speed；respectively 標記兩個列表按順序一一對應。

options.text: approximately
options.zh: 大約
options.whyZh: 近似數量或程度與這裡的確切名稱對應無關。

questions.explanationZh: 第一項數量對應 Volume，第二項時間對應 Speed；respectively 標記兩個列表按順序一一對應。
questions.evidence: The first dashboard reports the number of support tickets. The second reports the average response time. On the summary slide, these two dashboards are labeled “Volume” and “Speed,” respectively.

vocabulary.note: 量的是多久後收到回覆，不是回覆的數量。

questions.prompt: The gallery permits only graphite pencils for sketching near the paintings. Try sketching with a pencil _____ drawing with a felt-tip marker.
questions.promptZh: 美術館只允許參觀者在畫作旁用石墨鉛筆速寫。請試著用鉛筆速寫，_____ 用麥克筆畫圖。

options.text: in addition to
options.zh: 除了……以外還
options.whyZh: in addition to 會要求除了用鉛筆還用麥克筆，與只准用石墨鉛筆相反。

options.text: rather than
options.zh: 而不是
options.whyZh: 館方只准用石墨鉛筆，應選用鉛筆而不是麥克筆，rather than 表示以一種方式取代另一種。

options.text: as a result of
options.zh: 由於
options.whyZh: as a result of 表結果的原因；前文是在規定可用的工具，並不是說用了麥克筆所以才要改用鉛筆。

options.text: prior to
options.zh: 在……之前
options.whyZh: prior to 表示先用鉛筆後用麥克筆；原句禁止後者，並不是安排先後順序。

questions.explanationZh: 館方只准用石墨鉛筆，應選用鉛筆而不是麥克筆，rather than 表示以一種方式取代另一種。
questions.evidence: The gallery permits only graphite pencils for sketching near the paintings. Try sketching with a pencil rather than drawing with a felt-tip marker.

vocabulary.note: 筆尖用纖維製成，和石墨鉛筆是兩種不同的畫具。

questions.prompt: The bulletin board next to the elevator _____ displayed staff notices, but it now shows only the building map.
questions.promptZh: 電梯旁的公告欄 _____ 張貼員工公告，但現在只展示大樓地圖。

options.text: currently
options.zh: 目前
options.whyZh: currently 表目前，不能自然修飾本句的過去式 displayed，且與現在只展示地圖不符。

options.text: tomorrow
options.zh: 明天
options.whyZh: displayed 是過去式，tomorrow 表將來，與現在和過去的用途對照不一致。

options.text: forthcoming
options.zh: 即將到來的
options.whyZh: 是形容詞，不可修飾 displayed，且時間方向並非過去。

options.text: formerly
options.zh: 以前
options.whyZh: formerly 指以前，用 but it now 對照公告欄的舊用途和現用途。

questions.explanationZh: formerly 指以前，用 but it now 對照公告欄的舊用途和現用途。
questions.evidence: The bulletin board next to the elevator formerly displayed staff notices, but it now shows only the building map.

vocabulary.note: 可張貼通知或地圖，不指樓層本身。

questions.prompt: The dance studio has one exception to its barefoot rule. Enter the studio barefoot _____ the instructor has given you permission to wear clean indoor shoes.
questions.promptZh: 舞蹈教室規定赤腳進入，但有一項例外。請赤腳進入教室，_____ 指導老師已准許你穿乾淨的室內鞋。

options.text: unless
options.zh: 除非
options.whyZh: 預設赤腳；得到老師許可才可例外穿室內鞋，用 unless 引出允許例外的條件。

options.text: every time
options.zh: 每次
options.whyZh: every time 表示每當得到許可時都要赤腳，沒有表達許可會改變規則。

options.text: even if
options.zh: 即使
options.whyZh: even if 表示縱使獲准仍須赤腳，與第一句說有例外相衝突。

options.text: after
options.zh: 在……之後
options.whyZh: after 把赤腳要求安排在取得穿鞋許可之後，沒有解釋許可如何成為例外。

questions.explanationZh: 預設赤腳；得到老師許可才可例外穿室內鞋，用 unless 引出允許例外的條件。
questions.evidence: The dance studio has one exception to its barefoot rule. Enter the studio barefoot unless the instructor has given you permission to wear clean indoor shoes.

vocabulary.note: enter barefoot 是無鞋狀態下進入；barefoot 也能作形容詞。

questions.prompt: The caterer has prepared an estimate but will not order any ingredients yet. The booking is _____ on written approval of the estimate.
questions.promptZh: 外燴商已擬好估價，但還不會先訂食材。預訂 _____ 估價獲得書面核准。

options.text: exempt
options.zh: 免除的
options.whyZh: exempt 常和 from 搭配，表示不須遵守某要求，與必須先取得核准的條件相反。

options.text: contingent
options.zh: 取決於
options.whyZh: contingent on 表示是否成立取決於一項條件，先取得書面核准才會確定這筆預訂。

options.text: entitled
options.zh: 有權獲得的
options.whyZh: entitled 通常搭配 to，表示有權利；不是預訂等待客戶核准的意思。

options.text: comparable
options.zh: 可比較的
options.whyZh: 常用 comparable to/with 談比較對象，這裡並沒有比較兩筆預訂。

questions.explanationZh: contingent on 表示是否成立取決於一項條件，先取得書面核准才會確定這筆預訂。
questions.evidence: The caterer has prepared an estimate but will not order any ingredients yet. The booking is contingent on written approval of the estimate.

vocabulary.note: 用 written 區分書面和口頭同意。

questions.prompt: The leaflet was the only thing I meant to take. A loose bookmark had slipped between its pages, so I _____ carried the bookmark home as well.
questions.promptZh: 我原本只打算拿那份摺頁。有一張書籤掉進了頁面之間，所以我也 _____ 把書籤帶回家。

options.text: strategically
options.zh: 有策略地
options.whyZh: 原先只想拿摺頁，多帶走一張夾在裡面的書籤不是刻意安排的策略。

options.text: habitually
options.zh: 習慣性地
options.whyZh: 文字只說這次有東西夾在頁面間，沒有說帶走書籤是習慣。

options.text: deliberately
options.zh: 故意地
options.whyZh: 原文說唯一想拿的是摺頁，夾進去的書籤不是故意帶走的。

options.text: inadvertently
options.zh: 無意間
options.whyZh: 書籤夾在摺頁間才順帶被帶回去，並不在原計畫裡，因此用 inadvertently 表示無意間。

questions.explanationZh: 書籤夾在摺頁間才順帶被帶回去，並不在原計畫裡，因此用 inadvertently 表示無意間。
questions.evidence: The leaflet was the only thing I meant to take. A loose bookmark had slipped between its pages, so I inadvertently carried the bookmark home as well.

vocabulary.note: loose 在這裡指沒有固定在冊頁上的物件。

questions.prompt: When the afternoon supervisor opened the log, she saw that the morning crew _____ the shortage before anyone asked for a recount.
questions.promptZh: 下午班主管打開紀錄，看到早班在有人要求重新盤點前 _____ 這次短少的情況。

options.text: had recorded
options.zh: 早已記下
options.whyZh: 主管打開紀錄並看見內容是過去的時間點，早班登記更早發生；過去完成式 had recorded 表達先後。

options.text: has recorded
options.zh: 已記下（現在完成）
options.whyZh: 現在完成式以現在為基準，本句要對照 she saw 的過去基準，且另有明確較早事件。

options.text: will record
options.zh: 將記下
options.whyZh: 紀錄已在下午看得到，不是當時尚未發生的未來事件。

options.text: is recording
options.zh: 正記下
options.whyZh: 現在進行式不能表示主管當時看到已存在的早班紀錄。

questions.explanationZh: 主管打開紀錄並看見內容是過去的時間點，早班登記更早發生；過去完成式 had recorded 表達先後。
questions.evidence: When the afternoon supervisor opened the log, she saw that the morning crew had recorded the shortage before anyone asked for a recount.

vocabulary.note: recount 在這裡是名詞，重新確認件數。

questions.prompt: The music school scheduled the two lessons _____, so one ends at the exact minute the other begins.
questions.promptZh: 音樂教室把兩堂課 _____ 安排，因此第一堂結束的時刻正是另一堂開始的時刻。

options.text: at random
options.zh: 隨機地
options.whyZh: 隨機排定與課程剛好緊接不是同一概念，後句在解釋沒有空檔。

options.text: in advance
options.zh: 事先
options.whyZh: 指提早安排，不說兩堂課中間是否有空檔。

options.text: back-to-back
options.zh: 緊接著
options.whyZh: 一堂結束的同一刻另一堂開始，表示兩堂課中間沒有休息時間。

options.text: on demand
options.zh: 依需求提供
options.whyZh: 說明服務依請求提供，不代表兩堂課安排在連續時段。

questions.explanationZh: 一堂結束的同一刻另一堂開始，表示兩堂課中間沒有休息時間。
questions.evidence: The music school scheduled the two lessons back-to-back, so one ends at the exact minute the other begins.

vocabulary.note: schedule 作動詞時指排定時間。

questions.prompt: The replacement cable has neither the locking tab _____ the colored marker shown in the setup guide.
questions.promptZh: 替換線材既沒有設定指南所示的卡扣，_____ 沒有指南所示的彩色標記。

options.text: yet
options.zh: 不過
options.whyZh: yet 可連接對比或表尚未，不是 neither 並列否定用法的小詞。

options.text: and
options.zh: 而且
options.whyZh: and 一般做並列，但既有 neither 須與 nor 成對表示兩者皆無。

options.text: or
options.zh: 或者
options.whyZh: or 通常搭配 either；在標準書面句式中，neither 搭配 nor。

options.text: nor
options.zh: 也
options.whyZh: neither the locking tab nor the colored marker 明確指出兩項都沒有。

questions.explanationZh: neither the locking tab nor the colored marker 明確指出兩項都沒有。
questions.evidence: The replacement cable has neither the locking tab nor the colored marker shown in the setup guide.

vocabulary.note: tab 是小片或凸耳，這裡供線材固定。

questions.prompt: A recording contained a steady hum even when the room was empty. The hum stopped when the ventilation unit was switched off and returned when it was switched on. The technician _____ the hum to the ventilation unit.
questions.promptZh: 即使房間沒有人，錄音裡仍有持續的嗡嗡聲。關閉通風裝置時，嗡嗡聲消失；重新開啟時，聲音又出現。技術人員將這個聲音 _____ 通風裝置。

options.text: compared
options.zh: 比較
options.whyZh: compare A to B 是比較兩種事物；句子用開關狀態辨認嗡嗡聲的來源，不是比較聲音與設備。

options.text: attributed
options.zh: 歸因於
options.whyZh: attribute A to B 表示判斷 B 是 A 的原因。嗡嗡聲隨設備關閉而消失，再開啟時出現，支持這個歸因。

options.text: submitted
options.zh: 提交
options.whyZh: submit 是呈交文件、申請或資料；嗡嗡聲不是呈交給通風裝置的東西。

options.text: contributed
options.zh: 促成、捐助
options.whyZh: contribute to 指促成一項結果，原句需要把嗡嗡聲連回造成它的設備，不是嗡嗡聲促成設備。

questions.explanationZh: attribute A to B 表示判斷 B 是 A 的原因。嗡嗡聲隨設備關閉而消失，再開啟時出現，支持這個歸因。
questions.evidence: A recording contained a steady hum even when the room was empty. The hum stopped when the ventilation unit was switched off and returned when it was switched on. The technician attributed the hum to the ventilation unit.

vocabulary.note: steady 指聲音持續、平穩，並非忽大忽小或時有時無。

questions.prompt: Mira cannot attend the race kit pickup. A signed note authorizes her teammate to collect the kit _____ Mira.
questions.promptZh: Mira 無法前往領取賽事物資包。一份已簽署的代領單授權隊友 _____ Mira 領取物資包。

options.text: in front of
options.zh: 在……前面
options.whyZh: 空間位置在跑者前方不是代領；跑者本人也不會到場。

options.text: due to
options.zh: 由於
options.whyZh: 表原因，不能表示獲得當事人授權而替她完成領取。

options.text: on behalf of
options.zh: 代表、代替
options.whyZh: 隊友獲當事人授權，持簽署領取單替她領取，符合 on behalf of。

options.text: in spite of
options.zh: 儘管、即使有……的阻礙
options.whyZh: 表示不受某人或某情況阻礙，不是當事人同意的代理行為。

questions.explanationZh: 隊友獲當事人授權，持簽署領取單替她領取，符合 on behalf of。
questions.evidence: Mira cannot attend the race kit pickup. A signed note authorizes her teammate to collect the kit on behalf of Mira.

vocabulary.note: pickup 在這裡指前往已安排地點領取物品。

questions.prompt: Version 2 tells staff to record expansion dates in a shared wall calendar. The notice says Version 3 is now in effect: record the dates only in the project file and stop marking the wall calendar. Version 3 _____ the earlier instructions.
questions.promptZh: 第 2 版要求員工將擴建日期記在共用掛曆上。公告說第 3 版已生效：日期只記在專案檔案中，掛曆不再標記。第 3 版 _____ 較早的指示。

options.text: repeats
options.zh: 重複
options.whyZh: 新版要求停止在掛曆上標記，改在專案檔案記錄，並非照錄先前的指示。

options.text: supplements
options.zh: 補充
options.whyZh: 只在檔案記錄且停用掛曆，與舊版使用掛曆互斥，不是讓新舊規則並存的補充。

options.text: supersedes
options.zh: 取代並使舊版失效
options.whyZh: 新版說只在專案檔案記錄且停止使用掛曆，與舊規則互斥；supersede 表新版取代舊版，不再並行適用。

options.text: illustrates
options.zh: 以例說明
options.whyZh: 新版更改日期記在哪裡，不是給原有掛曆規則加一個例子。

questions.explanationZh: 新版說只在專案檔案記錄且停止使用掛曆，與舊規則互斥；supersede 表新版取代舊版，不再並行適用。
questions.evidence: Version 2 tells staff to record expansion dates in a shared wall calendar. The notice says Version 3 is now in effect: record the dates only in the project file and stop marking the wall calendar. Version 3 supersedes the earlier instructions.

vocabulary.note: 指某規定現行有效、不再只是草案。

questions.prompt: A guide is available for the sculpture trail, but visitors can also walk the trail on their own. You _____ join a group to see the sculptures.
questions.promptZh: 雕塑步道有導覽員，也可以自行走完全程。要欣賞雕塑，你 _____ 參加團體。

options.text: are not allowed to
options.zh: 不准
options.whyZh: 自行參觀是一個選項，不代表園方禁止團體導覽。

options.text: do not have to
options.zh: 不必
options.whyZh: 有導覽也能自行參觀，兩者擇一即可，所以參團不是必要條件。

options.text: are required to
options.zh: 必須
options.whyZh: 第一句明確說可以自行走完全程，因此參加團體不是看到雕塑的前提。

options.text: must never
options.zh: 絕不可
options.whyZh: 導覽是允許的選項，不是任何時候都禁止參團。

questions.explanationZh: 有導覽也能自行參觀，兩者擇一即可，所以參團不是必要條件。
questions.evidence: A guide is available for the sculpture trail, but visitors can also walk the trail on their own. You do not have to join a group to see the sculptures.

vocabulary.note: walk on your own 指不跟團也能自行走訪。

questions.prompt: _____ a steady rain, the pottery stall stayed open under its canopy, and customers could still pick up their orders.
questions.promptZh: _____ 持續下雨，陶器攤仍在遮棚下營業，顧客仍可取貨。

options.text: Despite
options.zh: 儘管
options.whyZh: 雨本可能妨礙戶外攤位營業，但攤位仍然開著，despite 可直接接 a steady rain 談這種反差。

options.text: Since
options.zh: 自從／因為
options.whyZh: since 引導原因通常需子句；此處不是以降雨解釋營業原因，也沒有標出起始時間。

options.text: Unless
options.zh: 除非
options.whyZh: 此處 unless 應接表示條件的子句，a steady rain 是名詞片語。

options.text: Once
options.zh: 一旦
options.whyZh: once 在這裡不能直接接 a steady rain 引出已發生事件，也無法表示儘管下雨仍營業。

questions.explanationZh: 雨本可能妨礙戶外攤位營業，但攤位仍然開著，despite 可直接接 a steady rain 談這種反差。
questions.evidence: Despite a steady rain, the pottery stall stayed open under its canopy, and customers could still pick up their orders.

vocabulary.note: steady 描述雨勢持續，不必然是大雨。

questions.prompt: Each planning team has a separate notes file. Keep the original details, but produce one master file instead of three separate copies. Please _____ the notes into a single document.
questions.promptZh: 各規劃小組有各自的筆記檔案。保留原有細節，但請整理成一份總檔，而不是三份分開的檔案。請把筆記 _____ 成一份文件。

options.text: archive
options.zh: 歸檔
options.whyZh: archive 表示保存歷史資料，不一定會把多份筆記寫成同一份總檔。

options.text: discard
options.zh: 拋棄
options.whyZh: 原文要求保留所有細節，不是丟掉資料。

options.text: isolate
options.zh: 隔離
options.whyZh: isolate 傾向讓資料彼此分開，與合成一份總檔相反。

options.text: consolidate
options.zh: 合併、整合
options.whyZh: consolidate A into B 明確把原本分開的資料合成單一文件，符合指定的整理方式。

questions.explanationZh: consolidate A into B 明確把原本分開的資料合成單一文件，符合指定的整理方式。
questions.evidence: Each planning team has a separate notes file. Keep the original details, but produce one master file instead of three separate copies. Please consolidate the notes into a single document.

vocabulary.note: 此處是彙整各小組資料後的主要檔案。

questions.prompt: The new park shelter, _____ opened yesterday, gives cyclists a dry place to wait during rain showers.
questions.promptZh: 公園裡新設的遮棚（_____ 於昨天開放）讓單車騎士在陣雨時有乾燥的等候處。

options.text: where
options.zh: 在那裡
options.whyZh: where 作關係副詞時表示地點，不能充當 opened 的主詞。

options.text: which
options.zh: 它（指前述遮棚）
options.whyZh: which 指前面的 shelter，是 opened 的主詞；逗號標示附加說明。

options.text: when
options.zh: 在那時
options.whyZh: when 指時間，不可指 shelter，也不能為 opened 提供主詞。

options.text: what
options.zh: 所……的事物
options.whyZh: what 自身包含先行詞，不能直接用在已經有 shelter 的非限定關係子句。

questions.explanationZh: which 指前面的 shelter，是 opened 的主詞；逗號標示附加說明。
questions.evidence: The new park shelter, which opened yesterday, gives cyclists a dry place to wait during rain showers.

vocabulary.note: shower 在天氣語境指短暫的一陣雨。

questions.prompt: The theater requires a short induction for every new backstage volunteer. Returning volunteers who completed the same course last month are _____ from that requirement.
questions.promptZh: 劇院要求每位新加入的後台志工接受簡短的入門訓練。上個月已完成同一門課程的回任志工，已 _____ 遵守這項要求的義務。

options.text: eligible
options.zh: 有資格的
options.whyZh: eligible 通常接 for 表取得某項服務的資格，句子談的是不必重上已修過的課。

options.text: dismissed
options.zh: 被解任的
options.whyZh: dismissed 指解除職務；課程要求不同並不意味回任志工不能繼續工作。

options.text: forbidden
options.zh: 被禁止的
options.whyZh: forbidden from 後可接動名詞表示不得做某事，而 that requirement 是名詞片語；免重上也不等於禁止參加。

options.text: exempt
options.zh: 免除
options.whyZh: exempt from 表不用遵守某一要求。已上過同樣課程的回任志工不必再上一次。

questions.explanationZh: exempt from 表不用遵守某一要求。已上過同樣課程的回任志工不必再上一次。
questions.evidence: The theater requires a short induction for every new backstage volunteer. Returning volunteers who completed the same course last month are exempt from that requirement.

vocabulary.note: induction 可指剛加入工作或志工團隊時的簡短介紹與訓練。

questions.prompt: The new foam pad arrived curled. Set it on a level board and let it _____ flat overnight.
questions.promptZh: 新的泡棉墊到貨時捲著。請把它放到一塊水平的板子上，讓它 _____ 過夜。

options.text: lie
options.zh: 平放著
options.whyZh: lie 是不及物動詞，let it lie flat 指讓泡棉墊保持平放，不必再接受詞。

options.text: lay
options.zh: 放置某物
options.whyZh: lay 表示主動放置某物，通常要接受詞；這一空是讓泡棉墊本身維持平放。

options.text: lying
options.zh: 平放著（分詞）
options.whyZh: 在 let it 後，用原形 lie，不接 lying。

options.text: lies
options.zh: 平放著（第三人稱單數）
options.whyZh: let 的受詞 it 後接動詞原形，不用第三人稱單數 lies。

questions.explanationZh: lie 是不及物動詞，let it lie flat 指讓泡棉墊保持平放，不必再接受詞。
questions.evidence: The new foam pad arrived curled. Set it on a level board and let it lie flat overnight.

vocabulary.note: level 作形容詞，指不傾斜。

questions.prompt: The travel office does not accept a single combined figure. Please _____ the rail fares, hotel charges, and taxi fares so that each amount appears on its own line.
questions.promptZh: 差旅辦公室不接受一筆合計數字。請 _____ 火車票價、旅館費與計程車費，每筆金額各占一行。

options.text: waive
options.zh: 免除
options.whyZh: 免除會取消收費義務，但題目沒有要免付任何一筆費用。

options.text: estimate
options.zh: 估算
options.whyZh: 估算是推算未知數字，沒有確保各種費用分開列出。

options.text: itemize
options.zh: 逐項列出
options.whyZh: each amount appears on its own line 說明每筆獨立列示，符合 itemize。

options.text: round
options.zh: 四捨五入
options.whyZh: round 調整數字的精確度，不會解決費用混成一筆的問題。

questions.explanationZh: each amount appears on its own line 說明每筆獨立列示，符合 itemize。
questions.evidence: The travel office does not accept a single combined figure. Please itemize the rail fares, hotel charges, and taxi fares so that each amount appears on its own line.

vocabulary.note: figure 在本句指一個數目，而非圖形。

questions.prompt: I left before the short film began because nobody told me it was included in the ticket. _____ known it was included, I would have stayed.
questions.promptZh: 沒人告訴我門票包含短片放映，所以我在播放前離開了。_____ 早知道門票包含這部短片，我就會留下來。

options.text: Should I
options.zh: 萬一我
options.whyZh: Should I 加原形適合尚未發生的條件；本句與過去事實相反，且後面是 known。

options.text: Were I
options.zh: 如果我是／如果我要……
options.whyZh: Were I 可接 to 加動詞原形、名詞或形容詞，但不能直接接 known 表「我早知道」。

options.text: If I have
options.zh: 如果我已經
options.whyZh: 現在完成式不能表達此處已經錯過且與實際過去相反的條件。

options.text: Had I
options.zh: 如果我（與過去事實相反）
options.whyZh: Had I known 是 If I had known 的倒裝；後句 would have stayed 對應與已知過去相反的未發生結果。

questions.explanationZh: Had I known 是 If I had known 的倒裝；後句 would have stayed 對應與已知過去相反的未發生結果。
questions.evidence: I left before the short film began because nobody told me it was included in the ticket. Had I known it was included, I would have stayed.

vocabulary.note: included 表既有門票涵蓋該活動，不需另買一項。

questions.prompt: The supplier allows the shop to pay the same total in four equal payments, one each month, instead of paying all at once. The shop can pay _____.
questions.promptZh: 供應商允許商店把同一筆總額分成四筆等額付款，每月付一筆，不須一次付清。商店可以 _____ 付款。

options.text: in full
options.zh: 全額
options.whyZh: in full 強調付清全額，不說明分幾次；原文強調每月付一筆，共四筆。

options.text: in installments
options.zh: 分期
options.whyZh: 四筆等額、按月支付而非一次付款，正是 installments。

options.text: in advance
options.zh: 預先
options.whyZh: 原文沒有說要在交貨前付款；付款頻率和是否預付是兩件事。

options.text: in cash
options.zh: 以現金
options.whyZh: 付款分幾次與付款工具不相同，原文沒有指定現金。

questions.explanationZh: 四筆等額、按月支付而非一次付款，正是 installments。
questions.evidence: The supplier allows the shop to pay the same total in four equal payments, one each month, instead of paying all at once. The shop can pay in installments.

vocabulary.note: pay all at once 表示一次支付全部金額。

questions.prompt: At each setting we tested, the preview loaded faster when we used fewer images. The fewer images the page contains, _____ it loads.
questions.promptZh: 每一組設定測試中，圖片較少時預覽都載入得更快。網頁含的圖片越少，載入就 _____。

options.text: the faster
options.zh: 越快
options.whyZh: The fewer …, the faster … 以雙比較級表示兩個變化的對應，也符合測試結果。

options.text: the slowest
options.zh: 最慢
options.whyZh: slowest 是最高級，而且方向與測試所說較快相反。

options.text: faster than
options.zh: 比……快
options.whyZh: faster than 必須再接比較對象，且無法作為此雙比較級的第二部分。

options.text: as fast as
options.zh: 和……一樣快
options.whyZh: 同等比較也需要明確比較對象，本題在談兩變量的變化，不是兩個網頁速度相同。

questions.explanationZh: The fewer …, the faster … 以雙比較級表示兩個變化的對應，也符合測試結果。
questions.evidence: At each setting we tested, the preview loaded faster when we used fewer images. The fewer images the page contains, the faster it loads.

vocabulary.note: 指正式發布之前查看呈現結果的版本。

questions.prompt: The training summary will be shared with other teams. Keep the comments intact but _____ the names so that the shared copy does not identify the writers by name.
questions.promptZh: 訓練摘要會分享給其他小組。請保留完整留言，但 _____ 姓名，讓分享的版本不顯示留言者的姓名。

options.text: enlarge
options.zh: 放大
options.whyZh: 放大姓名讓它更容易辨識，與隱去姓名的目標相反。

options.text: alphabetize
options.zh: 按字母順序排列
options.whyZh: 排序不會移除姓名，其他小組仍可看見。

options.text: omit
options.zh: 略去
options.whyZh: omit names 是把姓名從共享摘要移除，符合保留留言但不揭露姓名的要求。

options.text: quote
options.zh: 引用
options.whyZh: 引用姓名會公開可識別的內容，與目標相反。

questions.explanationZh: omit names 是把姓名從共享摘要移除，符合保留留言但不揭露姓名的要求。
questions.evidence: The training summary will be shared with other teams. Keep the comments intact but omit the names so that the shared copy does not identify the writers by name.

vocabulary.note: intact 強調保留原內容，不做截斷或損傷。

questions.prompt: The neighborhood poetry reading usually follows a published order. Today a guest poet is leaving early, so the other readers decided to _____ her. She will read before anyone on the list.
questions.promptZh: 社區讀詩活動通常按公告順序進行。今天一位受邀詩人得提早離開，所以其他朗讀者決定 _____ 她。她會比名單上的所有人更早朗讀。

options.text: catch up with
options.zh: 追上
options.whyZh: catch up with 指追上或了解近況，不表示把原屬自己的朗讀順序讓給她。

options.text: fall back on
options.zh: 求助於、依靠
options.whyZh: fall back on 表示需要依靠某人，其他朗讀者只是調整順序，並非請她代勞。

options.text: get back at
options.zh: 向……報復
options.whyZh: get back at 表示向某人報復，原句是為了配合提早離場而讓她優先。

options.text: make an exception for
options.zh: 為……破例
options.whyZh: make an exception for 表示為特定對象破例；原本按公布的順序朗讀，其他人為了讓提早離場的詩人也能朗讀，決定讓她先讀。

questions.explanationZh: make an exception for 表示為特定對象破例；原本按公布的順序朗讀，其他人為了讓提早離場的詩人也能朗讀，決定讓她先讀。
questions.evidence: The neighborhood poetry reading usually follows a published order. Today a guest poet is leaving early, so the other readers decided to make an exception for her. She will read before anyone on the list.

vocabulary.note: order 在這裡指節目先後，不是訂單或命令。

questions.prompt: The tasting booth no longer stocks disposable stirrers. Staff will hand out washable teaspoons _____ the old stirrers, not alongside them.
questions.promptZh: 試飲攤已不再備有一次性攪拌棒。攤位人員會用可清洗的茶匙 _____ 原先的攪拌棒，而不是兩種一起提供。

options.text: in advance of
options.zh: 早於、在……之前
options.whyZh: in advance of 表示時間先後，沒有指出茶匙是在取代攪拌棒。

options.text: in lieu of
options.zh: 代替
options.whyZh: in lieu of 表示拿茶匙替換已停止提供的攪拌棒；not alongside them 明確排除同時提供。

options.text: in view of
options.zh: 考慮到
options.whyZh: in view of 引出原因或背景，不是說茶匙和攪拌棒互相替代。

options.text: in addition to
options.zh: 除了……還
options.whyZh: in addition to 表示另加茶匙，與攤位不再提供舊攪拌棒矛盾。

questions.explanationZh: in lieu of 表示拿茶匙替換已停止提供的攪拌棒；not alongside them 明確排除同時提供。
questions.evidence: The tasting booth no longer stocks disposable stirrers. Staff will hand out washable teaspoons in lieu of the old stirrers, not alongside them.

vocabulary.note: disposable 指設計為用後丟棄的。

questions.prompt: A gardener _____ drawing was selected for the seed-packet design stopped by to collect the original sketch.
questions.promptZh: 有位園藝工作者前來領回原始草圖，_____ 圖稿被選為種子包裝上的圖案。

options.text: whose
options.zh: 其（表示所屬）
options.whyZh: whose 放在 drawing 前表畫稿屬於這位園藝工作者。

options.text: whom
options.zh: 誰（受格）
options.whyZh: whom 作受詞，不可直接放在 drawing 前表示擁有。

options.text: where
options.zh: 在那裡
options.whyZh: where 指地點，不能表示這位園藝工作者與圖稿之間的所有關係。

options.text: which
options.zh: 哪一個／那個
options.whyZh: which 可以指物，但此處須指出圖稿屬於前面的 gardener。

questions.explanationZh: whose 放在 drawing 前表畫稿屬於這位園藝工作者。
questions.evidence: A gardener whose drawing was selected for the seed-packet design stopped by to collect the original sketch.

vocabulary.note: original 指最初的一份，而非包裝上重製的樣子。

questions.prompt: The source recording must remain [131] _____.
questions.promptZh: 原始錄影必須維持 [131] _____。

options.text: portable
options.zh: 可攜的
options.whyZh: 備忘錄沒有談檔案能否搬到另一設備；需要保留原本的完整素材。

options.text: compressed
options.zh: 壓縮的
options.whyZh: 壓縮是調整檔案大小，不是用不改動原檔的方式保留可復原素材。

options.text: optional
options.zh: 可選的
options.whyZh: 原始錄影必須保留，原文不是說是否保留全憑校對者決定。

options.text: untouched
options.zh: 原樣
options.whyZh: 只可修改工作副本，原始錄影必須不變，才能找回被誤移除的素材。

questions.explanationZh: 只可修改工作副本，原始錄影必須不變，才能找回被誤移除的素材。
questions.evidence: Reviewers may change the copy, but the source recording must remain untouched so that the editor can recover any material removed by mistake.

vocabulary.note: 專為修改或校對而另存，與原始檔區隔。

questions.prompt: Enter the timestamp [132] _____ the first word in the same row.
questions.promptZh: 請將時間戳記 [132] _____ 第一個詞寫在同一列。

options.text: instead of
options.zh: 代替
options.whyZh: 上一句要求確切時間和第一個詞都要寫，不能以其中一項替代另一項。

options.text: along with
options.zh: 連同、以及
options.whyZh: 同一列要同時放時間和第一個詞，用 along with 表示兩個都附上。

options.text: except for
options.zh: 除了……之外
options.whyZh: except for 引出排除的項目；第一個詞是定位字幕所需資料，不能排除。

options.text: regardless of
options.zh: 不管
options.whyZh: regardless of 表不需理會某事；第一個詞是明列的必填欄位，不能忽略。

questions.explanationZh: 同一列要同時放時間和第一個詞，用 along with 表示兩個都附上。
questions.evidence: Write both the exact time and the first visible word in the log. Enter the timestamp along with the first word in the same row so the editor can locate the right caption.

vocabulary.note: 用來精確標記音訊或影片中的時間位置。

questions.prompt: Which sentence best fits blank [133]?
questions.promptZh: 哪個句子最適合填入 [133]？

options.text: The completed log will be displayed outside the screening room.
options.zh: 完成的紀錄表會在放映室外展示。
options.whyZh: 這句只說在哪裡展示紀錄表，沒有提出任何建議字詞，無法承接下一句的 those suggested phrases。

options.text: Return the source recording to the entrance desk when your review is complete.
options.zh: 校對完成後，將原始錄影交還入口櫃檯。
options.whyZh: 校對人員用的是工作副本，且這句沒有提出任何可加進逐字稿的字詞。

options.text: If a caption is inaccurate, write a suggested replacement in the log.
options.zh: 若字幕不正確，請在紀錄表填上建議替換的字詞。
options.whyZh: 下一句 those suggested phrases 指向此處建議替換的文字；以紀錄表收集建議，再依建議更新逐字稿，流程一致。

options.text: Keep notes about the video separate from the timestamp log.
options.zh: 把影片筆記與時間戳記紀錄分開保管。
options.whyZh: 這句只說如何分開保存筆記，沒有提出任何可供下一句採用的建議字詞。

questions.explanationZh: 下一句 those suggested phrases 指向此處建議替換的文字；以紀錄表收集建議，再依建議更新逐字稿，流程一致。
questions.evidence: If a caption is inaccurate, write a suggested replacement in the log. The editor will use those suggested phrases to update the text transcript, but the video itself will not be edited during this review.

vocabulary.note: 將錄音或影片之中的語言內容以文字呈現；不等於已替換畫面字幕。

questions.prompt: Please hand the completed log to Lydia [134] _____ noon tomorrow.
questions.promptZh: 請 [134] _____ 明天中午把填好的紀錄表交給 Lydia。

options.text: by
options.zh: 最晚在
options.whyZh: by 接明確時點來設定提交截止；Lydia 會在截止後統一彙整。

options.text: since
options.zh: 自從
options.whyZh: since 指已發生的起點，明天中午在未來，且這裡需要提交截止。

options.text: for
options.zh: 預定在……（此處指安排在中午）
options.whyZh: for noon 可表示安排在中午，但不能用來說最晚須在中午之前或中午當下交件。

options.text: throughout
options.zh: 貫穿整段……
options.whyZh: throughout 要有一段可覆蓋的期間，不能用來指定一次交件的最晚時刻。

questions.explanationZh: by 接明確時點來設定提交截止；Lydia 會在截止後統一彙整。
questions.evidence: Please hand the completed log to Lydia by noon tomorrow. She will combine the notes after that deadline and bring them to the afternoon meeting.

vocabulary.note: 這裡是紀錄須提交的最晚時點，不是下午會議開始的時間。

questions.prompt: The foldout picture must be [135] _____ with the kit.
questions.promptZh: 摺頁圖必須隨套件 [135] _____。

options.text: returned
options.zh: 歸還
options.whyZh: 摺頁圖是套件的一部分，not kept 明確排除留下，應隨套件歸還。

options.text: enlarged
options.zh: 放大
options.whyZh: 沒有要求調整圖的大小；重點是套件借完時要連同此圖交回。

options.text: ordered
options.zh: 訂購
options.whyZh: 摺頁圖已附在每套套件中，借用者無須另買或訂購。

options.text: displayed
options.zh: 展示
options.whyZh: 後文所說展示的是完成後自行拍的照片，不是留下套件隨附的摺頁。

questions.explanationZh: 摺頁圖是套件的一部分，not kept 明確排除留下，應隨套件歸還。
questions.evidence: It shows what the finished puzzle should look like and must be returned with the kit, not kept as a souvenir.

vocabulary.note: foldout 可展開，比收起時大。

questions.prompt: The desk keeps extra pieces [136] _____ until their own puzzles are identified.
questions.promptZh: 櫃檯會將多出的拼片 [136] _____ 保管，直到查明原屬哪一套。

options.text: generously
options.zh: 慷慨地
options.whyZh: 慷慨是給予他人的態度，不說明如何保管不屬於本套的拼片。

options.text: permanently
options.zh: 永久地
options.whyZh: until 指確認原屬拼圖前的短期安排，並非永遠留在櫃檯。

options.text: separately
options.zh: 分開地
options.whyZh: 放入另備信封且不可加回本套，顯示多出來的拼片要分開收存。

options.text: openly
options.zh: 公開地
options.whyZh: 信封未封口不表示公開展示；規則重點是保管時不要混入套件。

questions.explanationZh: 放入另備信封且不可加回本套，顯示多出來的拼片要分開收存。
questions.evidence: The desk keeps extra pieces separately until their own puzzles are identified.

vocabulary.note: unsealed 說的是封口狀態，不代表內容需公開。

questions.prompt: Which sentence best fits blank [137]?
questions.promptZh: 哪個句子最適合填入 [137]？

options.text: Do not open an envelope at the counter without permission.
options.zh: 未經許可請勿在櫃檯打開信封。
options.whyZh: 信封用途已在前段說完；這裡在交代相片投稿與歸還套件的關係。

options.text: The foldout picture can be recycled when the puzzle is finished.
options.zh: 拼完後可把原附摺頁圖回收。
options.whyZh: 原附圖必須隨套件歸還；它也不是借用者拍攝的完成照片。

options.text: Keep all unfinished puzzles in the library until the weekend.
options.zh: 未完成的拼圖都留在圖書館，直到週末。
options.whyZh: 沒有週末留館規則，而且下一句說投稿不會延長借期，仍須準時歸還。

options.text: Please return the kit to the desk even if you submit a photo.
options.zh: 即使投稿了照片，仍請把整套拼圖歸還櫃檯。
options.whyZh: 前句允許投稿，後句強調借期仍照常；仍須歸還整套拼圖這句將展示與借用責任區分開來。

questions.explanationZh: 前句允許投稿，後句強調借期仍照常；仍須歸還整套拼圖這句將展示與借用責任區分開來。
questions.evidence: Borrowers may send us a photo of their completed puzzle for the display wall. Please return the kit to the desk even if you submit a photo. A submission does not extend the loan period.

vocabulary.note: submit 指交給主辦方審閱或使用。

questions.prompt: Return the kit [138] _____ you have finished the puzzle or not.
questions.promptZh: [138] _____ 是否已經拼完，都請歸還套件。

options.text: because
options.zh: 因為
options.whyZh: 原因連接詞不能承接句末 or not 所列的兩種可能，借期也不取決於是否拼完。

options.text: whether
options.zh: 無論
options.whyZh: whether … or not 表兩種情況都須歸還，後句也說不用在借期內拼完。

options.text: until
options.zh: 直到
options.whyZh: until 會把歸還綁到拼完這個時點，但後文清楚說不必在截止前拼完。

options.text: so that
options.zh: 以便
options.whyZh: so that 引出目的；歸還並不是為了讓人完成拼圖。

questions.explanationZh: whether … or not 表兩種情況都須歸還，後句也說不用在借期內拼完。
questions.evidence: Return the kit whether you have finished the puzzle or not.

vocabulary.zh: 讓其他人也能公平輪到
vocabulary.note: turn 在共用物品語境指依序使用的機會。

questions.prompt: Each uncommon name or abbreviation must be [139] _____.
questions.promptZh: 每個少見的人名或縮寫都必須 [139] _____。

options.text: listed alphabetically
options.zh: 按字母順序排列
options.whyZh: 字母排序方便查找，但不會說明一個陌生名稱或縮寫怎麼唸。

options.text: accompanied by a pronunciation note
options.zh: 加註唸法
options.whyZh: 後句說 so the interpreters know how to say it aloud；加註唸法對應此目的。

options.text: shown in bold
options.zh: 以粗體標示
options.whyZh: 粗體可以提示項目重要，但沒有提供聲音或讀法。

options.text: duplicated on every page
options.zh: 在每頁重複
options.whyZh: 多印幾次文字不會提供額外的發音資訊。

questions.explanationZh: 後句說 so the interpreters know how to say it aloud；加註唸法對應此目的。
questions.evidence: Each uncommon name or abbreviation must be accompanied by a pronunciation note so the interpreters know how to say it aloud.

vocabulary.note: 可以是名稱的簡稱，不必然逐個拼讀字母。

questions.prompt: Do not include a room number as a substitute [140] _____ the room name.
questions.promptZh: 請勿用房號 [140] _____ 房間名稱。

options.text: for
options.zh: 取代（a substitute for）
options.whyZh: a substitute for 後接被替代的項目，此處是口譯員要辨識的房間名稱。

options.text: about
options.zh: 關於
options.whyZh: about 表討論主題，不能和 a substitute 構成這裡的替代關係。

options.text: between
options.zh: 在……之間
options.whyZh: between 通常連接兩個對象，這裡只有一個被替代的名稱。

options.text: against
options.zh: 對抗
options.whyZh: against 可表抗衡或阻擋，不表示某物代替原物。

questions.explanationZh: a substitute for 後接被替代的項目，此處是口譯員要辨識的房間名稱。
questions.evidence: Do not include a room number as a substitute for the room name.

vocabulary.note: substitute 作名詞時常與 for 連用，引出原來使用的項目。

questions.prompt: Which sentence best fits blank [141]?
questions.promptZh: 哪個句子最適合填入 [141]？

options.text: Use the same typeface for the slide headings and the printed badges.
options.zh: 投影片標題和印製的識別證應使用同一字型。
options.whyZh: 這談設計一致性，沒有交代範例區存放什麼內容。

options.text: Ask the interpreters to bring both the East and the West room signs.
options.zh: 請口譯員帶上東室、西室兩個房間標示。
options.whyZh: 房間標示不是範例區的內容，不能銜接後句談的練習用途。

options.text: Place any extra practice lines in a section labeled “Examples.”
options.zh: 請把額外的練習句放在標成「範例」的區塊。
options.whyZh: 前段談正式資料，後句說範例不屬於論壇現場要口譯的內容；此句說明額外練習句放在何處。

options.text: Bring the printed slide packet to the booth one hour before the session.
options.zh: 請於場次前一小時把印好的投影片資料帶到口譯間。
options.whyZh: 這談交付時間，不交代哪些內容應放在練習用的範例區。

questions.explanationZh: 前段談正式資料，後句說範例不屬於論壇現場要口譯的內容；此句說明額外練習句放在何處。
questions.evidence: Place any extra practice lines in a section labeled “Examples.” The example section gives the interpreters a chance to practice; it is separate from the material they will interpret at the forum.

vocabulary.note: 在這裡指口譯員會在論壇正式口譯的內容。

questions.prompt: Tell the floor lead directly [142] _____ the shared file has already been printed.
questions.promptZh: 請直接告訴場務組長，[142] _____ 共用檔案已印妥。

options.text: before
options.zh: 在……之前
options.whyZh: has already been printed 表已印出；直接告知是因現在不能只更新共用檔，並非要求在印製之前通知。

options.text: unless
options.zh: 除非
options.whyZh: unless 會將「已印妥」變成不用通知的例外，而這正是必須直接告知組長的理由。

options.text: although
options.zh: 雖然
options.whyZh: 兩件事不是讓步反差；資料已印妥，合理解釋為何要另行口頭通知。

options.text: because
options.zh: 因為
options.whyZh: 共用檔已經印給口譯間，僅改線上檔無法讓口譯員立即知道，所以要通知場務組長。

questions.explanationZh: 共用檔已經印給口譯間，僅改線上檔無法讓口譯員立即知道，所以要通知場務組長。
questions.evidence: If a speaker makes a change on the morning of the forum, tell the floor lead directly because the shared file has already been printed for the booths.

vocabulary.note: 負責在活動場地協調人員或更新，不一定是講者本人。

questions.prompt: Assign one volunteer to wait at the pathway entrance and welcome [143] _____.
questions.promptZh: 請安排一位志工在步道入口等候並接待 [143] _____。

options.text: it
options.zh: 它
options.whyZh: 前文要接待的是複數的訪客；it 是第三人稱單數，也不指這群人。

options.text: they
options.zh: 他們（主格）
options.whyZh: welcome 後要接受詞；they 只能作主詞。

options.text: them
options.zh: 他們（受格）
options.whyZh: them 指上句晚到的訪客，且在 welcome 後作受詞。

options.text: us
options.zh: 我們
options.whyZh: us 指說話者和同伴，前文要接待的是晚到訪客，不是第一人稱「我們」。

questions.explanationZh: them 指上句晚到的訪客，且在 welcome 後作受詞。
questions.evidence: Some visitors will arrive after the briefing. Assign one volunteer to wait at the pathway entrance and welcome them.

vocabulary.note: 可指活動開始之前說明流程與注意事項的簡短集會。

questions.prompt: [144] _____, the guide can use a dim red light to illuminate features along the path.
questions.promptZh: [144] _____，領隊可以用微弱的紅光照亮步道旁的景物。

options.text: In particular
options.zh: 特別是
options.whyZh: 前句要求訪客不用手電筒，這句是給領隊另一種照明作法，不是舉例說明對訪客的限制。

options.text: Instead
options.zh: 作為替代
options.whyZh: 禁止訪客打手電筒而改由領隊用微弱紅光照亮沿途景物，後一句提出替代方式。

options.text: Similarly
options.zh: 同樣地
options.whyZh: 前句說訪客不開手電筒，後句說領隊能用紅光，兩者並非同樣做法。

options.text: Eventually
options.zh: 最後
options.whyZh: 後文沒有先試訪客手電筒再改紅燈的事件順序。

questions.explanationZh: 禁止訪客打手電筒而改由領隊用微弱紅光照亮沿途景物，後一句提出替代方式。
questions.evidence: Visitors should not turn on their flashlights during the walk. Instead, the guide can use a dim red light to illuminate features along the path.

vocabulary.note: 形容燈光亮度低，不是說看不見整個物件。

questions.prompt: Which sentence best fits blank [145]?
questions.promptZh: 哪個句子最適合填入 [145]？

options.text: Stop at the viewing area for a few minutes before starting the first demonstration.
options.zh: 請在觀賞區停幾分鐘，再開始第一段示範。
options.whyZh: 下一句 That pause 所指的短暫停留只有此句提供；也交代在觀察第一組星星之前先停一下。

options.text: Ask each visitor to bring a flashlight for the last part of the walk.
options.zh: 請每位訪客為最後一段路程攜帶手電筒。
options.whyZh: 這句沒引出停留，且前段要求步行中不開訪客手電筒。

options.text: Point toward the pathway entrance while continuing to walk.
options.zh: 請保持步行，並指向步道入口。
options.whyZh: continuing to walk 是不停下，與下句 That pause 直接矛盾。

options.text: Return the markers to the clubhouse before discussing the route.
options.zh: 請在討論路線前將標示送回社團會所。
options.whyZh: 後文要求收回前等兩組都用過；這句不提供下文說的觀星前停留。

questions.explanationZh: 下一句 That pause 所指的短暫停留只有此句提供；也交代在觀察第一組星星之前先停一下。
questions.evidence: Stop at the viewing area for a few minutes before starting the first demonstration. That pause gives visitors a chance to let their eyes adjust before looking for the first pair of stars.

vocabulary.note: 指安排供觀看的指定地點。

questions.prompt: Return them to the cupboard [146] _____ the last group has passed the viewing area.
questions.promptZh: [146] _____ 最後一組離開觀賞區，再把標示收回儲物櫃。

options.text: even though
options.zh: 儘管
options.whyZh: 最後一組已通過不是阻礙，而是可清理路線的時點。

options.text: before
options.zh: 在……之前
options.whyZh: 先收會使仍在行進的一組失去標示，與後句規定衝突。

options.text: as if
options.zh: 好像
options.whyZh: as if 表表象或假設；此處要求實際等待最後一組通過。

options.text: once
options.zh: 等到
options.whyZh: once 表等這個條件實際達成才收回，符合不得在仍使用時收走。

questions.explanationZh: once 表等這個條件實際達成才收回，符合不得在仍使用時收走。
questions.evidence: Return them to the cupboard once the last group has passed the viewing area. Do not collect the markers while either group is still using them.

vocabulary.note: leave something in place 指保持物品的位置不要挪動。

questions.prompt: At 9:45 on Saturday the duty manager approves Room B. The editor plans to send a public update at 10:00. At 10:20 building staff confirm they can unlock Room B at noon. Which pair of public updates would be accurate at the time each goes out? The program lists the foyer from eleven to two in both updates.
questions.promptZh: 星期六九點四十五分，值班主管核准使用 B 錄音室。編輯打算十點發布一則公開更新；十點二十分，館務人員確認中午能開門。下列哪一組內容在兩次發布當下都正確？兩次活動表的大廳時段都列為十一點到兩點。

options.text: 10:00 “Room B” with no time or note; 10:20 “Room B: time pending”
options.zh: 十點「B 錄音室」，不標時間也不附註；十點二十分「B 錄音室：時間待定」。
options.whyZh: 十點只寫名稱會被理解為十一點開放；十點二十分已確定中午開門，不再待定。

options.text: 10:00 “Room B: time pending”; 10:20 “Room B” with no time or note
options.zh: 十點「B 錄音室：時間待定」；十點二十分「B 錄音室」，不標時間也不附註。
options.whyZh: 前一則正確；後一則依預設仍表示十一點開放，不是已確認的中午。

options.text: 10:00 “Room B” with no time or note; 10:20 “Room B: noon”
options.zh: 十點「B 錄音室」，不標時間也不附註；十點二十分「B 錄音室：中午」。
options.whyZh: 後一則正確；前一則會讓人以為十一點已確定可進入。

options.text: 10:00 “Room B: time pending”; 10:20 “Room B: noon”
options.zh: 十點「B 錄音室：時間待定」；十點二十分「B 錄音室：中午」。
options.whyZh: 十點已有場地核准，可列出名稱但須標示時間待定；十點二十分得到開門時間，就改標中午。

questions.explanationZh: 場地核准和開門時間是兩件事。未填時間並不等於不承諾開放時間，公開活動表會把空白解讀為十一點。
questions.evidence: Once the duty manager clears Recording Room B for us, we can name it in the public program / If building staff haven’t confirmed an unlock time, mark the room’s opening time as pending. / a listed location with no time or note still defaults to eleven.

vocabulary.note: 場地已核准，開門時間仍未確認。

evidenceSpans.exactQuote: Once the duty manager clears Recording Room B for us, we can name it in the public program
If building staff haven’t confirmed an unlock time, mark the room’s opening time as pending.
a listed location with no time or note still defaults to eleven.

questions.prompt: What misunderstanding about the invitation would Rina’s edit most directly prevent?
questions.promptZh: 里娜修改邀請文字的位置，最直接要避免哪項誤會？

options.text: Thinking they can share a new story by stepping up to the microphone on Saturday.
options.zh: 以為週六可以走到麥克風前分享一個新故事。
options.whyZh: 「你有故事想分享嗎？」若和麥克風清單放在一起，容易被看成當場發言的邀請。移到下次活動的標題下，就能與週六現場設備的用途區分。

options.text: Thinking they should bring their own interview file to play through the headsets.
options.zh: 以為應帶自己的訪談檔案，用現場耳機播放。
options.whyZh: 耳機確實用來聆聽，但邀請文字沒有提到攜帶檔案，麥克風又是主持人開場用，當場發言的誤會更直接。

options.text: Thinking they can reserve a headset by writing to the archives address.
options.zh: 以為可以寫信到檔案館的聯絡地址預約一副耳機。
options.whyZh: 聯絡地址放在下次活動的邀請下，並不是週六耳機的預約方式。

options.text: Thinking the equipment listed for Saturday is what contributors should request for the next event.
options.zh: 以為週六清單上的設備就是投稿者應為下次活動申請的設備。
options.whyZh: 兩段分開是要避免把邀請當作週六能使用麥克風的訊息；活動也沒有請有意分享故事的人申請設備。

questions.explanationZh: 判斷的是措辭放在不同位置時造成的言外之意。週六是播放活動，麥克風只供主持人開場；分享故事的邀請是為了規劃下一次活動。
questions.evidence: Could “Have a story to share?” go under “Help shape the next archive event,” rather than below the list of Saturday’s equipment? / even if Room B is cleared, the microphone is for the host’s introduction.

vocabulary.note: 不是讓訪客使用麥克風。

evidenceSpans.exactQuote: Could “Have a story to share?” go under “Help shape the next archive event,” rather than below the list of Saturday’s equipment?
even if Room B is cleared, the microphone is for the host’s introduction.

questions.prompt: On Friday, Emil confirms he wants both stations held and sends one cleared excerpt. He expects a second excerpt to be cleared after the host sheet goes out. What would be consistent with Rina’s instructions?
questions.promptZh: 週五，艾米爾確認要保留兩個聆聽站，並寄來一段已獲授權的錄音摘錄。他預計第二段要等主持人工作表發出後才會獲准。哪項安排符合里娜的指示？

options.text: Put both stations in the setup duties but put the second excerpt in Notes; keep both reserved.
options.zh: 把兩站列為準備工作，但把第二段摘錄列入備註；保留兩站。
options.whyZh: 兩站確實都可保留，但第二站尚未取得可播放的摘錄，不能列成主持人現在就能做的準備工作。

options.text: Put the first station in the setup duties and the second in Notes; keep both reserved.
options.zh: 把第一站列為準備工作，第二站列入備註；保留兩站。
options.whyZh: 已收到一段授權摘錄，主持人能準備一站；第二站等待外部授權，可先保留但不能當作已可準備。

options.text: Put the first station in the setup duties and record the second as returned to the equipment pool.
options.zh: 把第一站列為準備工作，並註明第二站設備已歸還共用設備庫。
options.whyZh: 第一站處理正確，但週五已回覆保留兩站；第二站尚未能配置，不必因此退回設備。

options.text: Put both stations in Notes because neither can go into setup duties until the second excerpt arrives.
options.zh: 兩站都列入備註，因為在第二段摘錄到達前兩站都不能列為準備工作。
options.whyZh: 準備第一站不以第二段獲准為前提；現有的一段已足以準備第一站。

questions.explanationZh: 分清已保留、可以著手準備、仍待他人處理三種狀態。「保留」是設備安排，不代表授權程序已完成。
questions.evidence: On the internal host sheet, list setup the host can do and put anything still awaiting someone else in Notes. / A reply by Friday evening will hold them. / Leona, Saturday’s host, can prepare one station for each cleared excerpt she receives; until then, a held station can stay off the floor plan without going back into the equipment pool.

vocabulary.note: 保留一站仍不等於已獲准播放錄音。

evidenceSpans.exactQuote: On the internal host sheet, list setup the host can do and put anything still awaiting someone else in Notes.
A reply by Friday evening will hold them.
Leona, Saturday’s host, can prepare one station for each cleared excerpt she receives; until then, a held station can stay off the floor plan without going back into the equipment pool.

questions.prompt: Just after the event, Emil receives a signed online release for an excerpt whose catalog entry still has no audio link. The visitor wants to forward the listing now, but plans to describe it as “ready to listen to” only if their friend can actually hear it online. Which reply makes the right distinction and keeps the release moving?
questions.promptZh: 活動剛結束，艾米爾收到一份已簽署的授權書，允許將一段錄音摘錄發布到網路上；該摘錄的目錄項目仍未附音訊連結。訪客想現在就轉傳該項目，但只有朋友確實能在線上聆聽時，才想稱它為「現在可以聽」。哪句回覆正確區分目前的狀況，又能讓授權流程繼續？

options.text: “Send the listing as a reference, not as something playable yet. I’ll pass the release to the archive.”
options.zh: 「可以把目錄項目當參考資料傳給朋友，但現在還不能聽。我會把授權交給檔案館。」
options.whyZh: 目錄已公開，可立即分享；音訊尚未掛上去；合適做法是將授權書交給檔案館，由檔案館發布錄音並加入連結。

options.text: “Send the listing as ready to listen to. I’ll pass the release to the archive so the audio link appears there.”
options.zh: 「可以把目錄項目傳給朋友，告訴他現在就能聽。我會把授權交給檔案館，讓音訊連結顯示在那裡。」
options.whyZh: 交給檔案館正確，但收到授權不等於已刊登連結，不能說現在能聽。

options.text: “Wait to send the listing until it can be described as ready to listen to. I’ll pass the release to the archive.”
options.zh: 「等到可以說現在就能聽時，再把目錄項目傳給朋友。我會把授權交給檔案館。」
options.whyZh: 授權去向正確，但公開目錄現在已可當參考分享，不必等音訊。

options.text: “Send the listing as a reference. I’ll pass the release to the archive and send your friend the recording separately in the meantime.”
options.zh: 「可以把目錄項目當參考資料傳給朋友。我會把授權交給檔案館，同時另外寄錄音給你朋友。」
options.whyZh: 把目錄當參考、交出授權都正確，但這份線上授權允許檔案館新增音訊連結，但不授權艾米爾另寄錄音。

questions.explanationZh: 公開目錄項目、實際可以播放的音訊，以及允許誰發布音訊的授權是不同的事。不能用未發布的錄音承諾即時聆聽，也不能把發布授權當成寄送許可。
questions.evidence: People can open the archive’s public catalog entries from its links, but they won’t hear the recording there unless the archive has published it. / Send any separate online release to the archive, not to Saturday’s host. / An online release allows the archive to add an audio link to the catalog; it doesn’t authorize us to email people the file.

vocabulary.note: 僅讓檔案館上架連結，不允許直接寄出音檔。

evidenceSpans.exactQuote: People can open the archive’s public catalog entries from its links, but they won’t hear the recording there unless the archive has published it.
Send any separate online release to the archive, not to Saturday’s host.
An online release allows the archive to add an audio link to the catalog; it doesn’t authorize us to email people the file.
